items.title: Dueños de Chanel preparan la sucesión de su fortuna de US$86.000 millones y amplían su presencia en Suiza
items.author: Allegra Catelli, Ben Stupples
items.summary: Gerard Wertheimer, de 75 años, copropietario de la empresa que fabrica el famoso perfume Chanel Nº 5 y el icónico vestido negro, estableció una oficina familiar en Suiza para administrar parte de su f ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Durante décadas, Nueva York fue el centro de poder desde el que la familia propietaria del gigante de la moda Chanel administraba su fortuna multimillonaria. Ahora, uno de los integrantes de esa dinastía está desarrollando otra sede en Suiza. Gerard Wertheimer, de 75 años, copropietario de la empresa que fabrica el famoso perfume Chanel Nº 5 y el icónico vestido negro, estableció una oficina familiar en Suiza para administrar parte de su fortuna de US$43.000 millones, mientras la familia prepara el terreno para una nueva generación. El magnate, cuya familia directa lleva mucho tiempo formando parte de la élite de Ginebra, contrató hace unos años a Frederic Pasteau, exbanquero de banca privada de Credit Suisse, para dirigir la firma, según personas familiarizadas con el asunto que pidieron no ser identificadas por tratarse de información no pública. Ver más: Lamine Yamal luce reloj Richard Mille y bolso Chanel: ¿cuánto cuesta el look del futbolista? Pasteau, cuyo perfil de LinkedIn menciona a una oficina familiar anónima como su empleador, se asoció con Julie Bozzo-Gros, socia del bufete de abogados Gros & Waltenspühl, con sede en Ginebra y cuya familia mantiene estrechos vínculos con Gerard y Chanel, para establecer al menos dos entidades de inversión en la ciudad suiza a finales de 2025, según consta en los registros mercantiles. A principios de este año, una de esas entidades se posicionó como la compradora de una oficina en el corazón de Ginebra por 34 millones de francos suizos (US$40,8 millones). Estas empresas se suman a la incursión del clan en Suiza hace aproximadamente una década, cuando su oficina familiar, Mousse Partners, estableció una entidad en Ginebra llamada Mousseknuckle que, sin embargo, ha mostrado pocos indicios de actividad comercial. Mousse Partners, con sede en Nueva York, fue creada en 1991 por Charles Heilbronn, de 71 años, hermanastro de Gerard, para administrar la fortuna de la dinastía de la moda, que según el Índice de Multimillonarios de Bloomberg asciende a unos US$86.000 millones. La última iniciativa de Gerard en Suiza se produce en un momento en que él y otros miembros de la tercera generación de la familia, al igual que varios de los clanes más ricos del mundo, están poniendo en marcha estructuras de gestión patrimonial para sus descendientes, quienes participan cada vez más activamente en sus imperios. “Esto se parece menos a un cambio en la estrategia de inversión de Mousse que a una posible señal temprana de planificación de sucesión”, dijo Marc Debois, fundador de FO-Next, una firma de asesoría para familias ultrarricas y sus entidades de inversión. “La próxima generación podría estar asumiendo más responsabilidades mientras que el enfoque a largo plazo de la familia se mantiene intacto”. Pasteau, Bozzo-Gros y los representantes de Gérard Wertheimer no respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios. Chanel, con sede en Londres, se negó a comentar asuntos que no estuvieran directamente relacionados con la actividad de la empresa, al igual que Mousse Partners. Durante mucho tiempo, Mousse Partners ha sido el principal vehículo de inversión privada de la familia, con participaciones que abarcan desde startups de Silicon Valley hasta el histórico banco francés Rothschild & Co. Ver más: De Chanel a Louis Vuitton: las 10 marcas de lujo más buscadas en el mercado de segunda mano, según reporte Con Arthur, el hijo de 40 años de Heilbronn, entre sus ejecutivos, la empresa ahora cuenta con decenas de empleados que trabajan en una torre de cristal en la “Calle de los Multimillonarios” de Manhattan, lo que contribuye a convertir a la ciudad en un centro global para la fortuna familiar. Alain, el hermano de 78 años de Gerard y presidente ejecutivo de Chanel Ltd., tiene su domicilio en el mismo edificio, que se encuentra junto a una tienda insignia del imperio de la moda familiar. La diversificación geográfica es clave cuando una oficina familiar planifica la sucesión, afirmó Pierre Ricq, director general de Union Bancaire Privée. “Las familias pueden vivir, trabajar e invertir en varios países”, afirmó. “El objetivo es brindarles resiliencia y libertad de elección, manteniendo la claridad sobre quién toma las decisiones, cómo se comparte la información y qué mantiene unida a la familia”. Otros clanes multimillonarios con múltiples oficinas familiares incluyen la dinastía Pritzker, propietaria de los hoteles Hyatt, y los herederos del fundador de Walmart Inc. ( WMT ), Sam Walton, cuyas decisiones suelen estar motivadas por planes de sucesión que se consolidan a medida que sus fortunas crecen en tamaño y complejidad. Solo en la última década, el patrimonio neto conjunto de los Wertheimer se ha más que triplicado, lo que los sitúa a la altura de la realeza de Medio Oriente en la clasificación anual de Bloomberg sobre las mayores fortunas familiares. Chanel, que es una empresa de capital cerrado, ha repartido de forma constante dividendos por valor de varios miles de millones de dólares, lo que ha proporcionado a la familia una amplia flexibilidad para perseguir intereses financieros en diferentes jurisdicciones y clases de activos. Una encuesta realizada este año por Citigroup Inc. ( C ) a 351 clientes de family office reveló que aproximadamente un tercio de ellos prevé transiciones de liderazgo en los próximos cinco años. “El momento de la sucesión es el momento más vulnerable en la vida de cualquier familia, de sus líderes y de la oficina familiar”, dijo Raphael Amit, profesor de administración en la Wharton School. Ver más: Pedro Pascal apuesta por el reloj Boy·Friend de Chanel en México: así es y esto cuesta Otro estudio realizado este año por UBS Group AG, que analizó 307 family offices con un patrimonio medio de US$1.300 millones cada una, reveló que casi todas poseían activos bancarios en más de un territorio, siendo las de Estados Unidos y Suiza las que tenían mayor probabilidad de mantener inversiones en un mayor número de ubicaciones. Al igual que Estados Unidos, Suiza se encuentra entre los principales centros de riqueza del mundo, gracias a su estabilidad política, su alto nivel de vida y su amplia oferta de banqueros. Para Gerard, Suiza es una elección natural. Él y su familia han participado activamente en la vida social, cultural y filantrópica de Ginebra desde hace mucho tiempo. Su esposa, Valerie, fundó en 1999 una organización benéfica para proteger a los niños de los peligros en línea, que hace dos años organizó un evento de lujo con la actuación de la cantante Camila Cabello. Su hijo, David, dirige una empresa de inversiones con presencia en la ciudad, mientras que Gerard y su hija Olivia forman parte del consejo de administración de la Fundación Cassiopée, una organización sin ánimo de lucro con sede en Ginebra que concede subvenciones para la investigación médica y la cultura. Julie Bozzo-Gros, que participó en la constitución de las entidades de Gerard en Ginebra, colabora en las actividades de la fundación. Su padre, Bertrand Gros, de 76 años y expresidente del gigante relojero suizo Rolex SA, pasó a formar parte del consejo de administración de Chanel en diciembre de 2017, el mismo mes en que Gerard dejó ese mismo cargo. Las entidades de inversión creadas por Bozzo-Gros y Pasteau describen sus actividades como la realización de transacciones comerciales, financieras o inmobiliarias, según consta en su documentación de registro. Si nos guiamos por la firma Mousse Partners del clan, es probable que la oficina familiar suiza de Gerard opere discretamente. El sitio web de la firma neoyorquina, cuyo nombre proviene de la palabra francesa para “musgo”, ofrece poca información sobre sus inversiones y no menciona a los Wertheimer ni a los Heilbronn. Ver más: Disney presenta Infinity Vision a Paramount, Universal y otros estudios de Hollywood Principalmente muestra la imagen de un alce brincando rodeado de números romanos que representan el año de creación de la empresa en 1991, junto con la frase en latín del conocido proverbio: “Piedra que rueda no acumula musgo”. Haciendo eco del linaje de las familias Heilbronn y Wertheimer, dos ramas —una con flores y la otra con uvas— rodean al animal. En la parte inferior, las ramas se entrelazan formando una figura que evoca el famoso logotipo de Chanel de dos letras C entrelazadas, un guiño al origen de una fortuna que ahora echa raíces más profundas a casi 6.400 kilómetros de Nueva York. --Con la colaboración de Angelina Rascouet, Tara Patel y Katia Porzecanski. items.title: Lens hang on for much needed win to climb up Ligue 1 standings
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: RC Lens claimed only their second Ligue 1 win of the season on Friday after holding off second-placed Olympique Lyonnais for a 2-1 home victory.
items.body:
RC Lens claimed only their second Ligue 1 win of the season on Friday after holding off second-placed Olympique Lyonnais for a 2-1 home victory.
Veteran striker Florian Sotoca put the hosts ahead 10 minutes before the break and left back Matthieu Udol added the second 14 minutes from time as Lens dominated the game.
But when Udol was dismissed in the 84th minute, it offered Lyon a lifeline and they immediately pulled one back when teenager Khalis Merah took advantage of a defensive slip.
However, they proved unable to score a second goal and preserve their unbeaten start to the season.
Lens were last season’s runners-up but had made a slow start to the new campaign after seeing coach Pierre Sage leave for Crystal Palace and then firing his replacement Dino Toppmoeller four matches into the season.
Friday’s win was a first victory for new coach Yannick Cahuzac in his second game since taking over.
Success for Lens saw them leap from 15th spot to seventh in the standings, with seven points. Lyon remain second with 11 points.

items.title: Declaran culpables a tres por homicidio surfistas extranjeros norte México; fiscalía pide 210 años en prisión
items.author: Lizbeth Diaz
items.creator: Lizbeth Diaz
items.summary: Un juez mexicano declaró culpables el viernes a tres hombres por el asesinato de dos surfistas australianos y un estadounidense en 2024, en un destino turístico de la costa del Pacífico, en el norte del país, informó una fuente del Poder Judicial del estado Baja California.
items.body:
Un juez mexicano declaró culpables el viernes a tres hombres por el asesinato de dos surfistas australianos y un estadounidense en 2024, en un destino turístico de la costa del Pacífico, en el norte del país, informó una fuente del Poder Judicial del estado Baja California.
Los hermanos australianos Jake y Callum Robinson, de entonces 30 y 33 años, respectivamente, y su amigo Carter Rhoad, de 30, realizaban un viaje de práctica de surf en una playa del municipio Ensenada, a unos cientos de kilómetros de la frontera con Estados Unidos. Al caer la noche, en la zona despoblada donde acampaban, fueron asesinados a tiros tras resistirse a un asalto.
"El fallo fue condenatorio", dijo la fuente del Poder Judicial estatal. "La lectura de la sentencia será viernes 16", agregó.
Los acusados fueron declarados culpables de homicidio calificado cometido con premeditación, alevosía y ventaja, así como de robo con violencia y robo de vehículo de motor con violencia, indicó la fuente.
Más tarde el viernes, la fiscal del estado Elena Andrade dijo que la dependencia a su cargo está solicitando hasta 210 años de prisión para "cada uno de los agresores", pero que al final será el juez quien determinará la pena. La funcionaria agregó que se mantendría en contacto tanto con familiares como con representantes consultares de las víctimas.
Los cuerpos de los extranjeros fueron encontrados días después de que su familia reportó su desaparición -en abril de 2024- dentro de un pozo de agua con heridas de bala en la cabeza. La camioneta en que viajaban, además, fue hallada calcinada en otro punto a varios kilómetros de la zona en que ocurrieron los hechos.
La fiscalía había solicitado previamente una pena de hasta 150 años de prisión para Jesús Gerardo "N", alias "El Kekas", señalado como el principal responsable del crimen.
El 19 de noviembre, Gisell Silva, entonces novia de "El Kekas", fue condenada a 20 años de prisión por su participación en el caso. La mujer de entonces 23 años fue detenida pocos días después de que fueron encontrados los cadáveres de los extranjeros.
Martin y Debra Robinson, padres de los hermanos, viajaron a México para asistir al juicio. Ellos han descrito lo que vivieron tras la muerte de sus hijos como "un infierno" y una experiencia "increíblemente difícil".

items.title: 米欧・ウクライナが和平案協議　米ロ軽油合意と同日
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン　９日 ロイター] - 米国、ウクライナ、欧州の交渉担当者が９日、マイアミでウクライナ戦争終結に向けた統一提案での合意を目指し、６時間にわたる協議を行った。協議に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。

匿名を条件に語った同関係者によると、今後数週間で案をまとめてロシアに提示し、冬を迎える前に事態の打開を図ることを目指している。

同日、トランプ米大統領は、燃料価格の引き下げに向けてロシアが世界市場にディーゼル（軽油）を供給することで合意したと発表。米政権は、ロシアの戦費となる収入を断つために課していたロシア産燃料への制裁を解除した。この合意は米議員やウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領から批判を浴びた。 

ゼレンスキー氏は声明で「資金は全て、人々に対する、ウクライナに対する、そしてわれわれ全員に対する戦争に使われる。わが交渉チームは単に目くらましに使われているに過ぎないと考えている。それは決して公正ではない」と述べた。

ロシアのプーチン大統領はトランプ氏との電話会談後、ウクライナによるモスクワへのドローン攻撃を理由に、和平協議を直ちに再開する可能性は低いとの見方を示した。

マイアミでの協議には米国のウィットコフ、クシュナー両特使とウクライナ代表団のほか、欧州と北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の代表者が出席した。

関係者によると、交渉担当者は幅広い議題について話し合った。その中には、米国と欧州による安全保障の確約を含むウクライナ向けの戦後パッケージも含まれた。

また、ウクライナ向けの戦後経済計画や、欧州連合（ＥＵ）加盟に向けた道筋についても協議された。

ただ関係者は、センシティブな問題として、領土を巡る「幾つかのアイデア」も議論されたとしたが、詳細には立ち入らなかった。

今後の平和な時代の土台となる、欧州とロシアの安全保障体制についても議論された。関係者は詳細には触れなかった。

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 9 : Amazon on Friday confirmed it was shuffling leadership in its Alexa division, a day after the company announced its first tablet computers featuring the voice assistant.
Daniel Rausch, a 17-year Amazon veteran who has served as vice president of Alexa and Echo for over three years, is stepping away from the unit next month, Amazon said in response to a Reuters inquiry.
Rausch, who has served as the face of Alexa at events and global launches, will return in another capacity in the devices and services division in 2027.
In his place, Amazon will install Aidan Marcuss, currently the vice president of Fire TV, advertising and the Amazon appstore. Marcuss joined Amazon from Microsoft in early 2025. He oversaw the release of a new Fire TV stick last month, which has garnered mixed reviews.

Kevin Keith, a product and marketing vice president, will keep that role but also take on Marcuss' responsibilities for the time being, Amazon said. The company declined to provide additional detail about the changes.
Alexa has been a consistent money-loser for Amazon since its release in 2014.
Amazon spent several years developing a new version of the voice assistant offering generative AI that can respond to longer prompts. The service is featured in the new Alexa Tablets announced on Thursday that Amazon has priced as a high-end product compared with prior Fire tablets that were inexpensive.
Alexa+, as the latest version is known, is included in the $139-per-year Prime membership or for $20 monthly as a standalone service.

items.title: Mexican court finds three men guilty of 2024 killing of Australian, US surfers
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Mexican judge on Friday found three men guilty of the 2024 murders of two Australian brothers and their American friend during a surf trip to the state of Baja California, a source at the court told Reuters.
items.body:
A Mexican judge on Friday found three men guilty of the 2024 murders of two Australian brothers and their American friend during a surf trip to the state of Baja California, a source at the court told Reuters.
Jesus Gerardo Garcia, known as "El Kekas," and the co-defendants identified simply as Irineo Francisco "N" and Angel Jesus "N," were found guilty of aggravated homicide, violent robbery and vehicle theft by a Baja California court.
The prosecution had sought sentences of up to 150 years against the suspects. According to the same source at the state court, the sentence will be announced on October 16.
Brothers Callum, 33, and Jake Robinson, 30, and American Jack Carter Rhoad, 30, were camping and surfing near Punta San Jose, about 80 km (50 miles) south of Ensenada, when they were reported missing in late April 2024.
After a days-long search, aided by the FBI, their bodies were found on May 3 at the bottom of a well. The victims were each found with gunshot wounds in the head, authorities said.
Prosecutors said the accused had attempted to carjack the tourists, who were shot when they tried to resist. Their truck was later found burned nearby.
Martin and Debra Robinson, the Robinsons' parents, traveled from their hometown of Perth to attend the four-week trial. Rhoad's widowed fiancee, Natalie Weirtz, spoke via video call from the United States.
In November 2025 Gisell Silva, Garcia's then-girlfriend, was sentenced to 20 years in prison for her involvement in the case. The woman, who was 23 at the time, was arrested a few days after the bodies of the victims were found.
While the Ensenada area is considered relatively safe, Baja California ranks among Mexico’s most violent states. Following the killings, the US State Department urged Americans to reconsider travel to the state due to crime and kidnapping risks.

items.title: Plantio de soja no Brasil vai a quase 20% da área, em ritmo recorde, diz Pátria
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O plantio da safra de soja 2026/27 do Brasil atingiu 19,77% da área total estimada, marcando o ritmo mais acelerado de semeadura já observado no país, com chuvas favorecendo as atividades nos campos, de acordo com dados da consultoria Pátria AgroNegócios divulgados nesta sexta-feira.
items.body:
O plantio da safra de soja 2026/27 do Brasil atingiu 19,77% da área total estimada, marcando o ritmo mais acelerado de semeadura já observado no país, com chuvas favorecendo as atividades nos campos, de acordo com dados da consultoria Pátria AgroNegócios divulgados nesta sexta-feira.
Na mesma época do ano passado, os trabalhos cobriam 12,86% da área, enquanto a média dos últimos cinco anos para o período é de 11,55%.
"Estamos vivenciando o mais acelerado ritmo de plantio da safra de verão brasileira", afirmou a consultoria em relatório.
Segundo a Pátria, o avanço tem sido favorecido pela chegada precoce e pelos volumes satisfatórios de chuvas nas principais regiões produtoras.
A aceleração dos trabalhos com a soja é importante para as culturas de segunda safra se desenvolverem dentro da melhor janela climática.
Além disso, pode permitir que colheita da soja seja antecipada, se as condições climáticas continuarem favoráveis, de forma geral, no maior produtor e exportador da oleaginosa.
"Abrindo bem a janela para segunda safra, até o momento. Estamos falando de soja plantada agora que entra em colheita em janeiro, excelente para colocar milho no chão", disse o diretor da consultoria, Matheus Pereira.
Na última semana, os destaques foram Mato Grosso, Goiás e Mato Grosso do Sul, que registraram rápido avanço dos trabalhos de campo.
A consultoria citou que 33,3% da safra já foi plantada em Mato Grosso, maior produtor brasileiro. O número está em linha com o anunciado mais cedo pelo Instituto Mato-grossense de Economia Agropecuária (Imea), que indicou um [USN:L1N45V0UW TEXT:"salto"] de mais de 20 pontos percentuais na semeadura do Estado.
Já no Paraná, o plantio evoluiu pouco em razão do excesso de precipitações, conforme havia alertado o Departamento de Economia Rural (Deral). Contudo, o Estado sulista está adiantado nos trabalhos de semeadura, com mais de 40% da área já plantada, após as chuvas terem chegado mais cedo este ano.
O diretor da Pátria disse ainda que, apesar da evolução no plantio, em partes de Mato Grosso, como o noroeste, alguns tiveram de replantar devido a condições desfavoráveis para o desenvolvimento.
"Centro-Norte do MT está precisando de chuvas. Pode ser um problema se novas rodadas não chegarem na próxima semana.", acrescentou ele.

items.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones finally puts her Welsh accent to work in show 'Kill Jackie'
items.author: Danielle Broadway, Rollo Ross
items.creator: Danielle Broadway, Rollo Ross
items.summary: It was not until Catherine Zeta-Jones began working on the Prime Video series "Kill Jackie" that she had an epiphany: for the first time in her career, she would be playing a character with a Welsh accent, matching her own.
items.body:
It was not until Catherine Zeta-Jones began working on the Prime Video series "Kill Jackie" that she had an epiphany: for the first time in her career, she would be playing a character with a Welsh accent, matching her own.
"Jackie Price is Welsh. Even her name sounds Welsh," Zeta-Jones told Reuters, referring to the former drug dealer turned art dealer she portrays in the series.
"Once that was in my head, there was no going back. I have to be honest, I got a little jealous of other actors who've never had to do accents all their lives," she added.
The Oscar-winning actor said the realization prompted her to reflect on a career spent almost exclusively playing characters with accents different from her own.
From using an American accent in the 2004 film "The Terminal" to adopting a Scottish accent in the 2008 film "Death Defying Acts," the Welsh actor has portrayed characters from around the world.
But the accent was not the only aspect of "Kill Jackie," which premiered on Prime Video in Britain, Canada and some other countries on October 2, that drew her to the role. It premiered in the US on AMC+.
Zeta-Jones was also captivated by the character herself: Jackie Price, a former cocaine dealer who lives a luxurious life selling art through tax loopholes.
After 20 years of anonymity, Jackie's quiet existence is upended when a group of elite hitmen known as The Seven Demons is hired to kill her.
The series also stars Daniel Ings, Julian Rhind-Tutt, Sidse Babett Knudsen and Christine Adams.
"She speaks before she thinks, and she says what she thinks," Zeta-Jones said of the qualities that made her connect with the character.
The "Ocean's Twelve" actor said she admires Jackie's unfiltered nature, particularly because her own demeanor tends to be more serious and restrained.

items.title: Lockheed Martin unveils PAC-3 Edge interceptor designed to counter hypersonic threats
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Lockheed Martin on Friday unveiled PAC-3 Edge, a missile interceptor designed to defend against hypersonic and advanced missile threats, as the US military looks to strengthen its capabilities to counter emerging aerial threats.
items.body:
Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) on Friday unveiled PAC-3 Edge, a missile interceptor designed to defend against hypersonic and advanced missile threats, as the US military looks to strengthen its capabilities to counter emerging aerial threats.
Growing demand for air and missile defense systems amid conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East has strained US weapons stockpiles, prompting the US Army to award Lockheed Martin a contract [USN:L1N43V1ND TEXT:"worth up to $58.6 billion"] in July to ramp up production of PAC-3 interceptors.
Lockheed Martin said PAC-3 Edge incorporates a new seeker, upgraded flight controls and a multi-pulse rocket motor supplied by Northrop Grumman, enhancing the interceptor's ability to counter advanced threats, including hypersonic missiles, at longer ranges and higher altitudes.
"The cost of this would be about that of the existing PAC-3 MSE," Tim Cahill, president of missiles and fire control at Lockheed Martin, told Reuters. "At full production, the annual rate would be about 2,000 units a year, comparable with PAC-3 MSE."
In January, Lockheed Martin [USN:L4N3Y714G TEXT:"signed"] a seven-year framework agreement with the US Department of Defense to expand production of its PAC-3 missile interceptors, aiming to increase annual manufacturing capacity to 2,000 units from about 600.

items.title: Fullkrug haunts former side as Bremen battle for 2-2 draw at Dortmund
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Niclas Fullkrug returned to haunt former club Borussia Dortmund as Werder Bremen came back from two goals down to earn a 2-2 draw on Friday, with the Bundesliga leaders dropping points for the first time this season.
items.body:
Niclas Fullkrug returned to haunt former club Borussia Dortmund as Werder Bremen came back from two goals down to earn a 2-2 draw on Friday, with the Bundesliga leaders dropping points for the first time this season.
Dortmund were cruising 2-0 with two minutes remaining but somehow contrived to draw the game, denying them the chance to win their first five league games in a campaign for the first time since 2015.
Dortmund move to 13 points from five matches and have opened up a three-point lead at the top of the table over second-placed Bayern Munich, who have a game in hand.
All four goals in the game came in the final 10 minutes as Daniel Svensson and Nico Schlotterbeck scored in front of the Yellow Wall, who were left feeling a little 'green' by the end of the evening.
That looked to have put the home side in control of the contest, only for Ludovit Reis and Fullkrug to put on a late show for the visitors.
Fabio Silva’s miskicked attempted shot fell kindly for Svensson to score from 10-yards on 80 minutes.
Nico Schlotterbeck had pulled out of Germany’s squad with injury ahead of the international break, so it was a surprise to see him starting for Dortmund. His towering header from Joey Veerman’s corner made it 2-0.
That looked like game over, but Ludovit Reis’ superb low strike from outside the box pulled a goal back and Fullkrug made it 2-2 for the most unlikely of comebacks.
Dortmund coach Niko Kovac will be seething and left wondering how his side capitulated in the closing minutes. If they are to challenge Bayern for the title this season, they cannot drop points in this fashion at home.

items.title: Eztec eleva lançamentos em 53% no 3º tri
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A construtora e incorporadora Eztec anunciou nesta sexta-feira alta de 52,9% nos lançamentos de imóveis no terceiro trimestre ante o mesmo período de 2025, para R$726,5 milhões, segundo prévia de resultados do período divulgada ao mercado.
items.body:
A construtora e incorporadora Eztec (EZTC3.SA) anunciou nesta sexta-feira alta de 52,9% nos lançamentos de imóveis no terceiro trimestre ante o mesmo período de 2025, para R$726,5 milhões, segundo prévia de resultados do período divulgada ao mercado.
Os lançamentos corresponderam a três empreendimentos no período, feitos na região metropolitana de São Paulo.
Segundo a prévia, com o terceiro trimestre, a Eztec, que tradicionalmente é focada em segmentos de médio e alto padrões, acumulou nos nove primeiros meses deste ano R$2,4 bilhões em lançamentos, crescimento de 53,3% sobre um ano antes e recorde para a empresa no período.
Desse total, R$411 milhões foram voltados ao segmento econômico, que tem sido impulsionado no país nos últimos anos pelo programa federal Minha Casa Minha Vida. No acumulado de janeiro a setembro de 2025, os lançamentos da Eztec no segmento econômico tinham sido de R$110 milhões.
A companhia registrou vendas líquidas praticamente estáveis, a R$522,7 milhões entre julho e o final de setembro, recuo de 0,6% na comparação anual. No acumulado do ano até o mês passado, as vendas somaram R$1,8 bilhão, alta de 29,2% sobre o mesmo período de 2025 e também recorde para a empresa.
A Eztec terminou setembro com estoque total de R$3,5 bilhões, sendo R$1,1 bilhão em estoque pronto, R$1,36 bilhão em construção e R$1,1 bilhão de lançamentos.

items.title: Base Electron confidentially files for US IPO
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Power infrastructure firm Base Electron said on Friday it had confidentially filed for a U.S. initial public offering.
items.body:
Power infrastructure firm Base Electron said on Friday it had confidentially filed for a U.S. initial public offering.
The confidential filing comes as interest in AI-linked infrastructure remains strong, though investors are increasingly scrutinising valuations, capital needs and backlog quality.
Here are some details:
The number of shares to be offered and the price range for the proposed offering have not yet been determined, the company said.
Applied Digital (APLD.O) formed Base Electron to supply power to the technology firm's AI campuses under separate agreements.
Base Electron develops, owns and operates energy infrastructure serving data centers, AI facilities and large industrial users.
Cumulative spending globally on data centers alone could top $30 trillion by 2050, according to a projection by PwC.
In March, Base Electron approved a $2.4 billion [USN:L6N3ZS0X4 TEXT:"agreement"] with Babcock & Wilcox for equipment to support a 1.2-gigawatt power project serving Applied Digital's artificial intelligence campuses.

items.title: Guardians' Gavin Williams starting Game 5 vs. White Sox after closing Game 4
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Gavin Williams will start the decisive Game 5 of the American League Division Series against the Chicago White Sox on Saturday in Cleveland, two days after he closed out the Game 4 victory.
items.body:
Gavin Williams will start the decisive Game 5 of the American League Division Series against the Chicago White Sox on Saturday in Cleveland, two days after he closed out the Game 4 victory.
The right-hander needed 18 pitches to record three outs and finish the 9-5 road victory on Thursday when the Guardians evened the best-of-five series.
Cleveland manager Stephen Vogt said Friday that Williams recovered fine from the cameo appearance.
"So Gavin is ready to go tomorrow," Vogt said. "Feels good today. So we will obviously see how he's doing tomorrow."
Williams also started Game 2 on Monday when he struck out 11 in five-plus innings. He gave up two runs, four hits and three walks and received a no-decision in Cleveland's 4-3 loss.
Vogt said Williams will operate under normal conditions and able to pitch as long as necessary.
"I think we'll be watching the game," Vogt said. "I think we'll be monitoring it. But I think, again, it's a Game 5, win or go home. Gavin wants the ball. We want him to have the ball, and it's his game.
"And the game will tell us when it's time to move on, or maybe he takes it the whole way. We don't know. We gotta get there and find out."
Williams, 27, went 14-8 during the regular season with a 3.76 ERA and 248 strikeouts in 32 starts.
Right-hander Sean Burke will pitch for Chicago.
Burke, 26, earned the victory in the bulk relief role against Williams in Game 2. He gave up one run, one hit, one walk and struck out six in 5 1/3 innings.
Burke went 11-7 with a 3.34 ERA and 185 strikeouts in 32 appearances (27 starts) in the regular season.
Burke also has his sights on pitching as long as he can on Saturday.
"I empty the tank every single time I'm out there," Burke said Friday. "This is no different for me. Every single game I go out there, I'm giving 100 percent of everything I have, and I don't think tomorrow is any different.
"I think that I'll just embrace this moment. I love moments like these. I love being able to pitch in the big game. And just the fact that the coaching staff and the team trust me to go out there and do my thing tomorrow just means the world to me."
The White Sox won the first two games of the series in Cleveland before the Guardians returned serve and took two in Chicago.
--Field Level Media

items.title: GTCR, Elliott in advanced talks to buy CCC Intelligent Solutions, source says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Private equity firm GTCR and activist investor Elliott Investment Management are in advanced talks to acquire software provider CCC Intelligent Solutions , a source familiar with the matter said on Friday.
items.body:
Private equity firm GTCR and activist investor Elliott Investment Management are in advanced talks to acquire software provider CCC Intelligent Solutions (CCC.O) , a source familiar with the matter said on Friday.
Shares of the company, which provides software that helps auto insurers, repair shops, automakers and parts suppliers manage operations, rose about 13% in extended trading after Bloomberg News first reported the news.
A deal could be announced as soon as next week but a final agreement had not been reached, the source said, without disclosing financial details
CCC and GTCR did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment, while Elliott declined to comment
Bloomberg News had reported in August that online vehicle auctioneer Copart (CPRT.O) was in talks to acquire CCC
In July, Reuters had [USN:L6N43B182 TEXT:"reported"] that CCC was exploring a sale and that the Chicago-based company had hired Morgan Stanley to advise on the process and reached out to potential buyers, including private equity firms
Advent International, which acquired CCC in 2017 and took the company public through a merger with a special-purpose acquisition company in 2021, exited its investment in 2025 through a series of secondary share offerings, including the sale of its remaining stake

items.title: Eagles release QB Andy Dalton, rule out star RB Saquon Barkley vs. Jags
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Philadelphia Eagles released backup quarterback Andy Dalton on Friday among a flurry of roster moves ahead of their game Sunday against the Jacksonville Jaguars in London.
items.body:
The Philadelphia Eagles released backup quarterback Andy Dalton on Friday among a flurry of roster moves ahead of their game Sunday against the Jacksonville Jaguars in London.
The Eagles (2-2) ruled out star running back Saquon Barkley (hamstring) as well as safety Marcus Epps (groin), center/guard Drew Kendall (knee) and wide receivers DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Marquise Brown (ankle).
Those five players did not practice all week, nor did outside linebacker Jonathan Greenard (ankle), who is listed as questionable for the game against the Jaguars (3-1).
Starting quarterback Jalen Hurts made his first appearance on the practice report this season with a calf injury but was a full participant with no injury status for Sunday.
Philadelphia obtained Dalton from the Carolina Panthers on March 18 for a 2027 seventh-round pick. He played in one game, filling in when Hurts was being evaluated for a possible concussion. Dalton threw his lone pass for an interception in a 27-7 loss at Chicago on Sept. 28.
Dalton was demoted behind Tanner McKee, now the primary backup, with rookie Cole Payton, a fifth-round pick this year out of North Dakota State, also on the roster.
ESPN reported that Dalton could be a candidate for the Eagles' practice squad.
Dalton, who turns 39 on Oct. 29, served as a backup for Carolina for the previous three seasons under starter Bryce Young. He spent the first nine years of his career with the Cincinnati Bengals before having one-year stints with the Dallas Cowboys, Bears and New Orleans Saints.
In 180 games (169 starts), Dalton has thrown for 39,793 yards, 254 touchdowns and 152 interceptions with a career passer rating of 87.4. He has a career record of 84-83-2 as a starter and is a three-time Pro Bowl selection.
McKee, 26, has played in a total of six games (two starts) for the Eagles in parts of the previous two seasons and has completed 54 of 88 passes (61.4%) for 597 yards, five TDs and one pick. Philadelphia selected him in the sixth round of the 2023 NFL Draft.
The Eagles also announced on Friday that they have signed center Jake Majors and running back Carson Steele from the practice squad to the active roster and placed defensive tackle Uar Bernard on the practice squad injured list.
Philadelphia became thin at running back when both Barkley and Tank Bigsby were injured in the 24-20 loss to the Los Angeles Rams on Sunday. Bigsby was placed on IR with a core injury that requires surgery.
Will Shipley is expected to serve as the lead back for the Eagles, with running back Dameon Pierce elevated to their 53-man roster earlier this week.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Milho despenca em Chicago após USDA elevar a previsão de produtividade nos EUA
items.author: Karl Plume
items.creator: Karl Plume
items.summary: Os contratos futuros do milho negociados nos EUA despencaram em até o limite diário de negociação nesta sexta-feira e encerraram o dia com queda acentuada, depois que o Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA (USDA) surpreendeu os operadores com um aumento inesperado na previsão para a safra norte-americana de 2026.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros do milho negociados nos EUA despencaram em até o limite diário de negociação nesta sexta-feira e encerraram o dia com queda acentuada, depois que o Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA (USDA) surpreendeu os operadores com um aumento inesperado na previsão para a safra norte-americana de 2026.
O trigo seguiu a tendência de queda do milho, pressionado pelo aumento maior do que o esperado na previsão de estoques do USDA, enquanto a soja se recuperou de uma mínima de seis semanas e fechou o dia em alta.
O USDA previu a safra de milho dos EUA em 16,034 bilhões de bushels, acima da estimativa de 15,800 bilhões divulgada há um mês, com um rendimento médio de 181,2 bushels por acre, acima dos 178,5 bpa anteriores. A revisão elevou a previsão de estoques no final da safra em 282 milhões de bushels em relação ao mês anterior.
Analistas consultados pela Reuters esperavam, em média, que as estimativas de produção e rendimento médio diminuíssem devido às condições climáticas adversas para as culturas neste verão.
"Foi um choque o USDA constatar o aumento da produção este ano. E, de fato, o aumento que eles registraram foi um choque realmente grande. Portanto, foi um relatório negativo, obviamente, e o mercado está reagindo de forma negativa", disse Jack Scoville, analista do The Price Group.
Os futuros de milho para dezembro na bolsa de Chicago fecharam em queda de 20,50 centavos, atingindo a mínima de dois meses de US$4,7975 por bushel, após terem caído até o limite diário de 30 centavos após a divulgação do relatório. O contrato de referência registrou queda de 3,8% na semana.
A soja para novembro fechou com alta de 4,50 centavos, a US$12,92 o bushel, recuperando-se de uma mínima de seis semanas registrada após o USDA elevar suas previsões de produção e estoques nos EUA. Na semana, o contrato mais negociado registrou alta de 1,1%.
O contrato de trigo de dezembro da CBOT atingiu a menor cotação em dois meses e encerrou o dia com queda de 12,25 centavos, a US$6,71 por bushel. O contrato registrou sua sexta queda semanal consecutiva, recuando 1,8%.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Yasmine Ghania　Enas Alashray　Federico Maccioni

[ドバイ／カイロ ９日 ロイター] - イスラエルのテルアビブに向かっていたアラブ首長国連邦
items.body:
Yasmine Ghania　Enas Alashray　Federico Maccioni

[ドバイ／カイロ ９日 ロイター] - イスラエルのテルアビブに向かっていたアラブ首長国連邦 （ＵＡＥ）の格安航空フライドバイ機内で副操縦士が機長を襲撃した事件について、ＵＡＥ検察当局は９日、副操縦士は２００１年９月１１日に起きた米同時多発攻撃に触発され、この旅客機を乗っ取った上でテルアビブのベングリオン空港のターミナルに墜落させる自爆攻撃を計画していたと明らかにした。

ＵＡＥ検察当局は９月３０日の事件発生を受け、１０月１日に捜査に着手。ＵＡＥのアルシャムシ司法長官が発表した声明に、フライドバイによる不正行為を示唆する内容はなかった。副操縦士が米同時多発攻撃に影響を受けていたと公に確認されるのは今回が初めてとなる。

捜査当局はフライドバイの採用手続きを調査した結果、事件を起こした副操縦士は操縦士免許の保有や無犯罪証明書の提出など、全ての職業上および保安上の要件を満たしていたと確認。アルシャムシ司法長官は「いずれの手続きでも、副操縦士の過激思想や攻撃計画を実行する意図を示す兆候は見つからなかった」とした。

副操縦士は２９歳でオマーン国籍。アルシャムシ司法長官によると、２６年１月にフライドバイに入社する前、オマーン航空を含む複数の航空会社で勤務していた。捜査では、副操縦士がオーストラリアに留学していた１７年時点から、「過激主義とテロリズム」に傾倒し始めた兆候が確認されたとしている。また、副操縦士は「テロ」を扇動する資料を閲覧したり、ボクシングの訓練を受けたりして、攻撃に向けた精神的、身体的準備を進めていたと捜査当局に供述したことも明らかにした。

items.title: US lifts sanctions on daughter of Myanmar military-linked businessman
items.author: Simon Lewis
items.creator: Simon Lewis
items.summary: The United States lifted on Friday sanctions on the daughter of a Myanmar businessman accused of supporting the country's military, according to the US Treasury Department's website, after she filed a suit seeking removal from the blacklist.
items.body:
The United States lifted on Friday sanctions on the daughter of a Myanmar businessman accused of supporting the country's military, according to the US Treasury Department's website, after she filed a suit seeking removal from the blacklist.
The move comes after Reuters reported this week that the Trump administration had [USN:L6N45T16N TEXT:"opened talks with Myanmar's military-installed government"], reversing US policy that sought to isolate the generals who overthrew elected leaders in 2021.
It was unclear if the decision to remove Myanmar national Theint Win Htet from the Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN List) was a result of the talks.
After the 2021 coup, former President Joe Biden's administration imposed sanctions on senior Myanmar military officers and companies it accused of providing support for the military junta, which triggered a nationwide civil war that has killed an estimated 100,000 people and displaced more than 3.5 million.
The Treasury in January 2024 [USN:S0N3D107F TEXT:"targeted the "][USN:S0N3D107F TEXT:"Shwe Byain Phyu Group of Companies"], its founder Thein Win Zaw and his family, saying the company imported and distributed petroleum on behalf of the military and that the family owned at least 20 companies closely associated with the regime.
Thein Win Zaw's adult daughter, Theint Win Htet, sued the Biden administration seeking her removal from the SDN List, but her case was dismissed in February 2025. The sanctions freeze any US assets of those targeted and generally bar Americans from dealing with them.
The US in July 2025 [USN:L1N3TM01T TEXT:"lifted sanctions"] on several other Myanmar nationals and a firm under sanctions for aiding the military.
Theint Win Htet filed a new complaint in July this year, arguing that she has no active role in her father's business affairs, adding that the sanctions had interrupted her studies in the US, where she completed a bachelor's degree at New York University and was enrolled in a master's program at Columbia University.
"Plaintiff’s US credit cards have been blocked, her foreign bank accounts have been restricted, closed, or refused, and she has been unable to complete her university studies in the United States," said the complaint by Theint Win Htet, who said in the complaint she now lives with her mother in Bangkok. Her mother was removed from the sanctions list last year.
Campaign group Justice For Myanmar denounced the US move at a time when it said the Myanmar military was escalating attacks on civilians. "It is deplorable that the US government continues to delist Myanmar cronies and their family members that provide funding for the junta's terror," the group said.
Theint Win Htet's lawyer, Washington-based sanctions specialist Erich Ferrari, filed a notice with the US District Court for the District of Columbia on Friday voluntarily dismissing the lawsuit after her delisting. Ferrari declined to comment.

items.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（9日）ドル堅調、株・利回り上昇
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター

items.body:
＜為替＞　ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。市場で様子見姿勢が強まる中、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策の行方を見極めようと、ＦＲＢ当局者の発言が注目されている。    終盤の取引でドルは対円で０．２５％高の１５８．２５円。週間ベースで円は対ドルで４週連続で下落した。    ユーロ／ドルは０．１％安の１．１１９８ドル。週間ベースでは約０．５％下落した。週間ベースでは５週連続の下落で、２０２５年初旬以降で最長となった。ユーロはフランスの公的債務などに対する懸念などが重荷になり、５日の取引で１．１１６１ドルと１年５カ月ぶりの安値を更新していた。    世界の債券市場はこれまで売りが優勢だったが、トランプ米大統領が中間選挙前にイランを攻撃しないと表明し原油価格が下落したことなどで、この日は落ち着きを取り戻した。    ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げが決定される確率は１９．４％。ただ、その次の１２月８─９日のＦＯＭＣで利上げが決定される確率は８５．８％と、年内に追加利上げが実施されるとの観測は依然として強い。    来週はウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が１６日にタイのバンコクで開かれる国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）年次総会で講演を行う。    主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１３％高の１０２．２５。週間ベースでは約０．３％上昇。上昇は４週連続で、２５年５月以来の長さとなる。 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　国債利回りが上昇し、今週前半の低下分の一部を打ち消した。投資家は来週発表されるインフレ指標に注目。連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１０月２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で下す金利決定の手掛かりを見極めようとしている。     指標となる１０年債利回りは２．８ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の５．２６１％。ただ週間では３．５ｂｐ低下し、低下幅は過去２カ月で最大となった。     ２年債利回りは４．４ｂｐ上昇の４．７９９％。    ３０年債利回りは５．６０８％と小幅に上昇。週間では２．９ｂｐ低下した。      ２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は４５．５ｂｐと、８日終盤の４６．７ｂｐから縮小した。     市場は、来週発表されるインフレ指標に注目。消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は１４日、卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）は１５日にそれぞれ発表される。    金利先物市場が織り込む、ＦＲＢが今月のＦＯＭＣで金利を据え置く確率は８０％。 

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　主要３指数が揃って上昇して取引を終えた。投資家の関心は、本格化する第３・四半期決算発表や、インフレ指標の発表が予定される来週に移っている。    主要３指数は週間でもプラスとなった。ただ、小型株で構成するラッセル2000指数は前週末終値を下回って引けた。    第３・四半期の決算発表シーズンは来週本格化する。米大手銀のウェルズ・ファーゴ、ゴールドマン・サックス、シティグループ、ＪＰモルガン・チェース、バンク・オブ・アメリカ、モルガン・スタンレーが決算を発表する予定だ。    ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、アナリストはＳ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の７─９月期利益が前年比３０．６％増加すると予想。セクター別ではエネルギーが１２３％、テクノロジーが６６．５％と、前年比で最大の増益率が見込まれている。    この日は、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１セクターのうち、下落したのはコミュニケーション・サービスのみだった。    人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄は総じて上昇。ラウンドヒル・マグニフィセント・セブンＥＴＦは１％上昇した。    米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いるスペースＸは８日、全米をカバーする低周波数帯の利用権を取得する契約を結んだ。nL6N45V01U    これを受けて通信大手ＴモバイルＵＳ、ＡＴ＆Ｔ、ベライゾンは８．８─１３．３％下落した。    アップルは１．１％下落した。メモリーチップのコスト高騰と値上げが消費者需要を冷やす中、同社が一部サプライヤーに対し、新発売した「ｉＰｈｏｎｅ１８　Ｐｒｏ」と「ｉＰｈｏｎｅ１８　Ｐｒｏ　Ｍａｘ」向け部品の生産を削減するよう指示したと報じられた。    ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．６５対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値上がり銘柄が値下がり銘柄を１．３８対１の比率で上回った。    米取引所の合計出来高は１４３億７０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均（１７７億６０００万株）を下回った。 

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞　金は続伸し、１週間ぶり高値を付けた。中心限月の清算値（終値に相当）は１オンス＝４２１６．３ドル。金現物は東部夏時間午後３時２９分（日本時間１０日午前４時２９分）時点で１．５％高の４１９４．３６ドル。今週はドル高や米長期金利の上昇を受けて一時２カ月ぶり安値を付けたが、その後安値拾いの買いが入り、週末にかけて約１．３％の上昇となった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞　反発して取引を終えた。ハリケーン「イサイアス」がメキシコ湾北部に接近し、石油各社が同湾の原油生産の７０％超を停止したことが材料となった。    清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．４４ドル（０．４２％）高の１バレル＝１０４．７２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．３６ドル（０．３９％）高の９１．８５ドル。    取引序盤には原油価格は下落していた。トランプ米大統領が８日、１１月の米中間選挙前にイランへの攻撃は実施しないと表明し、戦争の終結に向けて両国は「建設的な」協議を行っていると発言したことを受けた。トランプ氏はまた、ディーゼル燃料に関して近く発表を行うと予告したほか、連邦ガソリン税の一時停止を検討していると述べた。     週間ベースでは、ブレント、ＷＴＩともに上昇の見通し。  

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

items.title: La audaz jugada de US$515 millones de Jaime Gilinski con un campo petrolero venezolano
items.author: Mie Dahl, Marcelo Rochabrun
items.summary: La forma en que Jaime Gilinski obtuvo los derechos del yacimiento Bare y luego acordó venderlos a cambio del control mayoritario de GeoPark es un ejemplo clave de la carrera por la riqueza que se libr ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Jaime Gilinski, el hombre más rico de Colombia, está a punto de convertir un contrato para un yacimiento petrolífero venezolano que le costó prácticamente nada en una participación de US$500 millones en una productora de crudo latinoamericana que ahora está a punto de controlar. La forma en que Gilinski obtuvo los derechos del yacimiento Bare y luego acordó venderlos a cambio del control mayoritario de GeoPark Ltd. es uno de los ejemplos más audaces hasta la fecha de la carrera por la riqueza que se libra en Venezuela. Tras años de mala gestión y sanciones paralizantes, Venezuela se ha convertido en el epicentro de la reafirmación del dominio hemisférico estadounidense por parte de la administración Trump, atrayendo a multitud de inversores influyentes que apuestan por el anunciado resurgimiento del país impulsado por el petróleo. Ver más: Mastercard entra al negocio del béisbol venezolano con un acuerdo por tres años con la LVBP Pocos han actuado con tanta rapidez como Gilinski, cuyo acuerdo ilustra cómo el sistema venezolano de asignación de recursos en la era posmaduro puede transformar un contrato estatal en un codiciado activo privado, sin necesidad de inversión inicial. Los detalles del acuerdo de Gilinski se han recabado a partir de documentos presentados ante las autoridades reguladoras, así como de personas familiarizadas con el acuerdo y de expertos que han solicitado el anonimato al tratar asuntos comerciales delicados. Otros acuerdos petroleros en Venezuela son menos transparentes, en parte porque no involucran a empresas que cotizan en bolsa como GeoPark. Gilinski se negó a hacer declaraciones para este artículo. Este ejecutivo, cuya fortuna asciende a US$40.000 millones según el Índice de Multimillonarios de Bloomberg , amasó inicialmente su fortuna en el sector bancario. Recientemente la ha multiplicado mediante una adquisición hostil de la mayor empresa de alimentos envasados de América Latina —Nutresa S.A.—, que tiene previsto utilizar para introducir café, galletas y otros productos en Venezuela. Después de que las fuerzas estadounidenses derrocaran a Nicolás Maduro en enero y la administración Trump suavizara las sanciones, el hijo de Gilinski, Gabriel, se reunió con la presidenta interina Delcy Rodríguez, respaldada por Estados Unidos, en marzo y viajó a Caracas más de diez veces en los meses siguientes. Los Gilinski evaluaron acuerdos para varios yacimientos petrolíferos potenciales, algunos de los cuales no se concretaron o fueron adquiridos por otros. Gilinski no es el único que se está apresurando a entrar en el mercado. Pacific Coast Energy Co., con sede en California, ha comenzado a operar dos bloques de petróleo pesado, mientras que nuevos actores de la industria, como Fred Ehrsam, cofundador de Coinbase —quien donó un millón de dólares al comité inaugural de Donald Trump en 2025—, han firmado sus propios acuerdos en Venezuela. Figuras con influencia durante la era Maduro, encabezadas por el empresario venezolano Alejandro Betancourt, están consolidando su posición, mientras que empresas más consolidadas se están preparando para su regreso, uniéndose a Chevron Corp. ( CVX ) y Repsol SA, que nunca se fueron. Ver más: Grupo de acreedores de Venezuela gana peso ante expectativas de reestructuración de la deuda ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. ( XOM ), que en enero calificó a Venezuela de “no apta para la inversión”, así como TotalEnergies, estuvieron presentes en una concurrida conferencia sobre petróleo y gas en Caracas la semana pasada. El frenesí empresarial provocó una auténtica avalancha de compradores de palos de golf. Tras meses de negociaciones con funcionarios en Caracas y Washington, Gilinski firmó el mes pasado un contrato de 25 años con el gobierno venezolano para operar el yacimiento de petróleo pesado Bare en la Faja Petrolífera del Orinoco. El yacimiento colinda con uno de los prolíficos bloques petroleros de Chevron, lo que ofrece la posibilidad de aprovechar las operaciones de la gran petrolera. Horas después, Gilinski acordó transferir el contrato de Bare a GeoPark a cambio de nuevas acciones, inicialmente valoradas en US$515 millones, lo que lo encamina a convertirse en el nuevo accionista mayoritario de la compañía. En este marco, GeoPark financiará cualquier nueva inversión en Bare y mantendrá una participación operativa neta del 65% en el yacimiento. El resto permanecerá en manos de la empresa estatal Petróleos de Venezuela SA (PDVSA). Este acuerdo convierte a GeoPark en una de las empresas venezolanas pioneras en un proyecto con objetivos de producción y planes de inversión definidos. GeoPark tiene como objetivo aumentar la producción diaria de Bare hasta los 95.000 barriles, frente a los 11.000 barriles actuales. En una entrevista concedida en Caracas la semana pasada, el CEO de GeoPark, Felipe Bayón, afirmó que la empresa estaba en conversaciones con PDVSA para acceder a una mezcla esencial que permita transportar el crudo de consistencia asfáltica. La empresa dispone de hasta 120 días para cumplir las condiciones del contrato y que el acuerdo entre en vigor, plazo que finaliza en diciembre. Si el contrato con Bare expira antes de que esto ocurra, la transacción con GeoPark se dará por terminada. Las acciones de GeoPark se han disparado desde la entrada de Gilinski en la compañía. Si el contrato con Venezuela sigue adelante, se espera que Gilinski ofrezca a los accionistas actuales la oportunidad de vender hasta US$100 millones en acciones a un precio superior al precio de cierre de la compañía, que fue de US$11,45 por acción el jueves. Ver más: Marco Rubio respalda a Dinorah Figuera y pide a la oposición venezolana negociar con el chavismo Poco después de la destitución de Maduro, Gilinski se propuso probar suerte en el sector petrolero venezolano, obteniendo rápidamente la exención de sanciones necesaria de la Oficina de Control de Activos Extranjeros (OFAC) del Departamento del Tesoro de EE.UU. para allanar el camino hacia la firma de un acuerdo. Su hijo Gabriel viajó a Washington para solicitar la licencia a las autoridades. Con la licencia de la OFAC en su poder, Gilinski también necesitaba una empresa petrolera para entrar en Venezuela. GeoPark, que cuenta con una sólida presencia en Colombia, tenía sus propias necesidades. En aquel momento, GeoPark se defendía de un intento de adquisición hostil que Gilinski bloqueó eficazmente al adquirir una participación del 20% en la empresa en marzo. Sin embargo, en lugar de recurrir a GeoPark para negociar un acuerdo petrolero en Venezuela, Gilinski cerró el trato con PDVSA prácticamente por su cuenta. La idea era obtener los derechos de al menos un yacimiento venezolano y rentabilizarlos ofreciéndolos a GeoPark. GeoPark afirmó que participó en las negociaciones con PDVSA antes de que se firmara el acuerdo sobre el yacimiento petrolífero, ya que poseía una participación del 5% en Bare desde el principio. Ahora se dispone a adquirir el 95% restante de Gilinski, ofreciéndole por el yacimiento un valor que se sitúa aproximadamente un 5% por debajo de la valoración determinada por sus asesores. El 4 de septiembre, Gilinski sorprendió a sus nuevos colegas de la industria petrolera al aparecer junto a Rodríguez en un discurso televisado desde Caracas anunciando el acuerdo. “Señora presidenta, gracias por su confianza”, dijo. “Gracias por abrirle esta puerta al Grupo Gilinski, a GeoPark. De parte de Gabriel y mía, muchas gracias”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Erwin Seba

[ヒューストン　９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Erwin Seba

[ヒューストン　９日　ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は反発して取引を終えた。ハリケーン「イサイアス」がメキシコ湾北部に接近し、石油各社が同湾の原油生産の７０％超を停止したことが材料となった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．４４ドル（０．４２％）高の１バレル＝１０４．７２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．３６ドル（０．３９％）高の９１．８５ドル。

取引序盤には原油価格は下落していた。トランプ米大統領が８日、１１月の米中間選挙前にイランへの攻撃は実施しないと表明し、戦争の終結に向けて両国は「建設的な」協議を行っていると発言したことを受けた。トランプ氏はまた、ディーゼル燃料に関して近く発表を行うと予告したほか、連邦ガソリン税の一時停止を検討していると述べた。 

週間ベースでは、ブレント、ＷＴＩともに上昇の見通し。

items.title: 'Avatar: The Last Airbender' expands with new prequel series 'Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos'
items.author: Danielle Broadway
items.creator: Danielle Broadway
items.summary: The world of successful TV franchise "Avatar: The Last Airbender" is expanding once again, with a new prequel series that will follow the story of a rebellious teenager Avatar — a being who controls the elements.
items.body:
The world of successful TV franchise "Avatar: The Last Airbender" is expanding once again, with a new prequel series that will follow the story of a rebellious teenager Avatar — a being who controls the elements.
Franchise co-creators Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko announced the animated TV series, titled "Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos," on Friday at New York Comic Con, with attendees getting a first look at Kuruk and his pet, Nikik.
Kuruk aims to stay "one step ahead of his angry teacher, rowdy pirates, and chaotic spirits, all while helping the world in his own unique ways," said a statement from Skydance (SKYD.N) .
The series is set to stream on Paramount+. No release date has been announced.
The Asian-inspired "Avatar: The Last Airbender" franchise follows a world divided into four elemental nations, where the Avatar alone can control water, fire, earth and air to maintain balance.
The original TV series has spawned two sequels, "The Legend of Korra," and "Avatar: Seven Havens."
"Seven Havens" has been renewed for two additional seasons, the statement from Skydance said.
DiMartino and Konietzko were involved in developing a live-action adaptation of the original "Avatar" series for Netflix (NFLX.O) before parting ways with the streamer in 2020, citing "creative differences." In 2021, they teamed with Nickelodeon to launch Avatar Studios, focused on expanding the universe of the original series through new films and television projects.

items.title: ロシア、米国向けディーゼル供給開始へ　米ロ首脳が電話会談
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [モスクワ　９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ　９日　ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は９日、ロシアは米国と世界市場向けに原油や石油製品を供給する用意があると述べ、ロシアによる供給は世界経済全体の支援につながるとの認識を示した。

トランプ米大統領はこれに先立ち、プーチン大統領と電話会談を行い、ロシアが米国と世界市場向けにディーゼル（軽油）３０万トン超を直ちに供給することで合意したと明らかにしていた。

ロシア大統領府が発表した声明によると、両首脳はロシアとウクライナの戦争終結に向けた方策のほか、イラン情勢についても協議した。

米ロ首脳の電話会談を受け、ロシアのノバク副首相は、ロシアは今月中にも米国やその他の国々向けにディーゼル供給を開始する用意があると表明。国内製油所は定期メンテナンス終了後に操業を再開するため、ロシアの石油製品輸出は１１月と１２月にさらに増加するとの見通しを示した。

また、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化を目的とした米国の取り組みを前向きに評価するとし、ディーゼル輸出規制の緩和を直ちに開始すると表明。輸出拡大後も国内市場へのディーゼル供給は十分に確保されると述べた。

items.title: India's TCS senior staff will miss out on variable pay for September quarter, memo shows
items.author: Sai B
items.creator: Sai B
items.summary: Senior staff at India's Tata Consultancy Services will miss out on quarterly bonuses after the company failed to meet performance targets, according to an internal memo seen by Reuters, the first time in at least two years all variable pay was withheld for some workers.
items.body:
Senior staff at India's Tata Consultancy Services (TCS.NS) will miss out on quarterly bonuses after the company failed to meet performance targets, according to an internal memo seen by Reuters, the first time in at least two years all variable pay was withheld for some workers.
"For associates C3A grade and above, there will be no QVA (quarterly variable allowance) this quarter. This decision was taken after careful consideration as our performance for the quarter fell short of internal targets," said Sudeep Kunnumal, chief human resource officer in the memo.
Associates in C3A and above grades are employees with typically 7-10 years of experience up to senior-level management. The junior-level employees will get 100% of the eligible pay, the memo added.
Mails sent to TCS did not elicit a response. Employees, speaking on the condition of anonymity, said typically the company awards 50-100% of variable pay and it is the first time in at least two years that the company has explicitly said no bonuses shall be awarded.
This comes as the country's largest IT firm reported its [USN:L6N45T0UF TEXT:"weakest"] September-quarter sequential revenue growth in three years, signaling continued pressure on traditional IT services demand even as AI-related revenue jumped nearly 20%. The uptick in AI revenue, however, was cheered by investors on Friday as the stock rose as much as 6.2%.
India's $315 billion IT sector is also facing uncertainty stemming from the Trump administration as it [USN:S0N43501J TEXT:"suspended"] major IT outsourcers including TCS, Infosys (INFY.NS) , HCLTech (HCLT.NS) from a key green-card program on Thursday, widening a crackdown it says targets fraud and protects American jobs.

items.body:
［ニューヨーク　９日　ロイター］　 - 米国株式市場は、主要３指数が揃って上昇して取引を終えた。投資家の関心は、本格化する第３・四半期決算発表や、インフレ指標の発表が予定される来週に移っている。

主要３指数は週間でもプラスとなった。ただ、小型株で構成するラッセル2000指数は前週末終値を下回って引けた。

ベアードの投資ストラテジーアナリスト、ロス・メイフィールド氏は「イランを巡るセンチメントが反転するなど、相場はこれまでと同様に一進一退の展開だ。ホワイトハウスや中東関係者から相反するヘッドラインが出ており、方向感がない」と指摘。「このため、今回の上昇は比較的勢いを欠く」と付け加えた。

第３・四半期の決算発表シーズンは来週本格化する。米大手銀のウェルズ・ファーゴ、ゴールドマン・サックス、シティグループ、ＪＰモルガン・チェース、バンク・オブ・アメリカ、モルガン・スタンレーが決算を発表する予定だ。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、アナリストはＳ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の７─９月期利益が前年比３０．６％増加すると予想。セクター別ではエネルギーが１２３％、テクノロジーが６６．５％と、前年比で最大の増益率が見込まれている。

この日は、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１セクターのうち、下落したのはコミュニケーション・サービスのみだった。

人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄は総じて上昇。ラウンドヒル・マグニフィセント・セブンＥＴＦは１％上昇した。

米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いるスペースＸは８日、全米をカバーする低周波数帯の利用権を取得する契約を結んだ。

これを受けて通信大手ＴモバイルＵＳ、ＡＴ＆Ｔ、ベライゾンは８．８─１３．３％下落した。

アップルは１．１％下落した。メモリーチップのコスト高騰と値上げが消費者需要を冷やす中、同社が一部サプライヤーに対し、新発売した「ｉＰｈｏｎｅ１８　Ｐｒｏ」と「ｉＰｈｏｎｅ１８　Ｐｒｏ　Ｍａｘ」向け部品の生産を削減するよう指示したと報じられた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．６５対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値上がり銘柄が値下がり銘柄を１．３８対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合計出来高は１４３億７０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均（１７７億６０００万株）を下回った。

items.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump said that he has struck a deal to obtain diesel from Russia, a stunning reversal of years of U.S. pressure on Moscow.
items.body: WASHINGTON — U.S. President Donald Trump said that he has struck a deal to obtain diesel from Russia, a stunning reversal of years of U.S. pressure on Moscow over its war with Ukraine and an attempt to address high fuel prices ahead of the U.S. midterm elections. Trump said on social media on Friday that he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call in which he was expected to discuss a suspected case of plague in Russia. Instead, Trump announced that Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel, followed by an additional 500,000 tons in November and one million tons “immediately thereafter.” Russia will deliver another three million tons “within a short period of time” after that, he wrote. Trump’s shocking announcement comes after he signed a sweeping Russia sanctions law last month that aimed at clamping down on Russia’s energy economy, among other areas, that fuel its war against Ukraine. His move casts doubt on the likelihood of the White House imposing sanctions on Russia this month, given that a bipartisan law passed by Congress directs the administration to target the top importers of Russian oil and gas. Trump, in his announcement, did not address the sanctions or Russia’s war but said, “Lower prices for Americans, especially our Great Farmers, Ranchers, and Truckers, is my Greatest Priority.” The White House did not immediately respond to questions about who was paying for the diesel from Russia and when the fuel being supplied under the agreement would become available. It also did not clarify whether subsequent supplies of Russian diesel set to come next month would be supplied prior to Election Day on Nov. 3. Gas prices globally have surged as the war in Iran upends the energy sector. While diesel future prices dipped on the news on Friday, the national average for a gallon of diesel in the U.S. was still US$6.23, according to AAA, after hitting a record US$6.52 on Sept. 22. A terse statement from Putin, released by the Kremlin on Friday, said that during his call with his U.S. counterpart, he and Trump dedicated “significant attention to the prospects of resolving the Ukrainian crisis” and also discussed “the situation around Iran and various aspects of bilateral relations.” Russia “confirmed its readiness to supply oil and oil products to the American and global markets,” Putin said. “I am confident that this will have a positive impact on the entire global economy.” The two leaders agreed to continue contacts, Putin said in the statement. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reacted sharply in a social media post, calling it a gift to Putin and saying that the Russian leader was trying to strike “backroom deals” to buy time in the war. “It plays into Russia’s hands -- allowing it to kill more, wage war for longer, have even less respect for America, and inflict even greater losses and damage on the world,” he said. Zelenskyy added in his post: “Russia will `repay’ the diesel with further terror and perfidy. Allowing Russia to sell petroleum products is an investment in a war that must be ended, not prolonged.” Rep. Don Beyer, the senior House Democrat on the Joint Economic Committee, called Trump’s announcement “infuriating.” “This is what we warned anyone who would listen: Trump isn’t the slightest bit trustworthy when it comes to Russia,” Beyer said in a statement on X. “Giving him expanded tariff powers in hopes he would use them to help Ukraine was a mistake. Now he’s lifting sanctions on Russian fossil fuels.” The law Trump signed last month envisions sanctions on Russian officials, banks and a shadow fleet of tankers and bans all new U.S. investment in Russia and the handling of sovereign debt. It also directed Trump to impose tariffs of up to 100 per cent on the top five importers of Russian oil or natural gas, with an exception for countries that import less than 15 per cent of Russia’s natural gas exports and have taken significant steps to reduce those imports. The U.S. has not imported Russian oil or gas since 2022, when the Biden administration banned them because of Moscow’s invasion of Ukraine, according to the U.S. Energy Information Administration. Shortly after Trump made the announcement, the U.S. Treasury Department said it was immediately issuing a temporary licence allowing Russian diesel to be supplied to the global market. This is the latest in several licences the U.S. Treasury has issued regarding Russian fuel shipments since the start of the Iran war earlier this year. But it is the first such licence to ease sanctions on diesel for a period lasting longer than the standard 30-day window since the start of the Ukraine war. The new so-called general licence means U.S. sanctions will not apply until April 2027 on deliveries of Russian diesel that has been loaded onto tankers as of Friday. The department extended similar easing of sanctions in March and April even though Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent had ruled out such a move earlier in the year. The extensions continue to underscore how the fallout from the Iran war has boosted Moscow’s ability to profit from its energy exports, which had been restrained by the U.S. and other allies since the invasion of Ukraine. ___ Michelle L. Price and Collin Binkley, The Associated Press Associated Press writer Will Weissert in Washington and Farnoush Amiri in New York contributed to this report.

items.title: Can Trump Fire Fed Governor Lisa Cook?
items.author: Erik Larson
items.creator: Erik Larson
items.summary: For more than a year, President Donald Trump has sought to push out members of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors and gain more leverage over the central bank’s policies. In early October, the White House resumed that effort, announcing the formation of a committee to investigate mortgage fraud allegations against board member Lisa Cook. She will be required to appear at a White House hearing on Nov. 5 to defend herself, Trump said in a memo.

items.title: S&P/TSX composite up more than 500 points, U.S. markets also rise
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Canada’s main stock index rose more than 350 points, helped by gains in the basic materials sector, while U.S. markets also gained ground.
items.body: TORONTO — Canada’s main stock index rose more than 500 points Friday to close out a volatile week as investors narrowed in on bond yields and the health of the Canadian economy.   The S&P/TSX composite index was up 519.24 points at 35,664.62.  In New York, the Dow Jones industrial average was up 423.31 points at 51,654.95. The S&P 500 index was up 46.18 points at 7,811.54, while the Nasdaq composite was up 172.83 points at 27,366.17.        The Canadian dollar traded for 70.07 cents US compared with 70.22 cents US on Thursday.     The November crude oil contract was up 36 cents US at US$91.85 per barrel.  The December gold contract was up US$59.30 at US$4,216.30 an ounce.

items.title: Surveillance Pricing May Be Coming to a Store Near You
items.summary:
What if the electronic shelf label you see at the grocery store isn't just showing you the price of the jar of mayonnaise you're about to buy — but actually raising the price because you put a can of tuna in your cart.

It's called surveillance pricing and retailers like Walmart appear to be locking down technology that will help them figure out how much they can charge you. Bloomberg's Brad Stone joins Stacey Vanek Smith and Max Chafkin on the Everybody's Business podcast to unpack this pricing strategy (which Walmart has denied using). (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Britain steps in to stop contentious Protestant parade in Northern Ireland
items.author: Amanda Ferguson
items.creator: Amanda Ferguson
items.summary: Britain's Northern Ireland minister on Friday overturned a decision by local authorities that granted a permit for a Protestant parade to pass through a Catholic area and triggered a two-week standoff that raised tensions in the region.
items.body:
Britain's Northern Ireland minister on Friday overturned a decision by local authorities that granted a permit for a Protestant parade to pass through a Catholic area and triggered a two-week standoff that raised tensions in the region.
Northern Ireland's Parades Commission last month [USN:L8N45H0SR TEXT:"allowed"] the Orange Order to march along the Garvaghy Road, a Catholic area in the mainly Protestant town of Portadown, for the first time since parades on the route were banned in 1998. Thousands of residents and protesters [USN:L1N45J00A TEXT:"stopped the parade"] from taking place.
A small number of Orange Order members have since remained at the start of the route, while a round-the-clock police presence has kept them separated from protesters 1.5 kilometres (1 mile) away on the footpaths of the Garvaghy Road.
Chris Bryant, Britain's secretary of state for Northern Ireland, said the region's police chief advised him that the parade could not go ahead without a major intervention from officers, which would carry "an unacceptable risk of serious injury, disorder and a wider contagion effect."
That official advice triggered a mechanism whereby Bryant could step in to overturn the Parades Commission's ruling.
"I have not taken this decision lightly," Bryant said in a statement, which also thanked the Orange Order for their peaceful and law-abiding approach throughout.
A lawyer representing Alan Hynes, a local Orange Order member, said in a statement that his client would challenge the minister's decision in court and request that the matter be listed before a judge on Saturday.
Bryant called for all protests, rallies and demonstrations to be stood down, saying there was no excuse for a continued ratcheting up of tensions.
Annual attempts by the Orange Order to march through the area had triggered unrest across the region until the route was banned nearly three decades ago, in the same year that the Good Friday Agreement largely ended three decades of violence in Northern Ireland known as the "Troubles."
"We don't view it as a victory but as a starting point because there are relationships within Portadown that need to be built and rebuilt," Breandán Mac Cionnaith, head of the Garvaghy Road Residents' Coalition, told national broadcaster RTE.
The decision was welcomed by the Irish government and by Northern Ireland's largest Irish nationalist party Sinn Fein, whose leader in Northern Ireland Michelle O'Neill is due to be [USN:L1N45V0MJ TEXT:"interviewed by police"] for taking part in the protest.
Sinn Fein's pro-British rivals, the Democratic Unionist Party, criticised the intervention, saying it was the "direct result of (Irish) Republican agitation, mobilisation and the looming threats of potential violence."
DUP leader Gavin Robinson said in a statement, however, that his party would not walk away from the region's fragile devolved government, where it shares power with Sinn Fein.

items.title: ゼレンスキー氏、米ロのディーゼル供給合意を非難　「戦争への投資」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[９日　ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は９日、米国とロシアがロシア産ディーゼル（軽油）の供給で合意したことについて、「終わらせるべき戦争への投資だ」と非難した。

ゼレンスキー氏は「ロシアのプーチン大統領に対する贈り物は、平和も、文明世界へのいかなる利益ももたらさない」とＸに投稿。「ロシアによる石油製品の販売を認めることは、終わらせるべき戦争を長引かせるための投資だ」とし、「必要なのはロシアとの相互的な形での真の緊張緩和だ」と訴えた。

さらにその後、通信アプリ「ワッツアップ」で記者団に対し、ウクライナ代表団がロシアとの戦争終結への協議に向けた訪米中に発表されたこの合意について、「われわれのチームは体裁を取り繕うために利用されているに過ぎないと考えている。それは決して公正ではないし、パートナー同士がとるべき態度でもない」と非難。「私の見方では、これは強い立場にあるパートナーが下した弱腰な決定だ」と述べた。 

トランプ米大統領はこの日、プーチン大統領との「極めて成功した」協議の結果、ロシアが米国と世界市場向けにディーゼル（軽油）３０万トン超を直ちに供給することで合意したと明らかにした。

ゼレンスキー大統領は前日、ロシアとウクライナの和平を仲介する米国主導の取り組みの一環として、ウクライナ代表団が９─１０日に米国で協議を行うと明らかにしていた。

items.title: 米アンソロピックのＡＩモデル、虚偽の殺人情報を警察サイトに送信
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[９日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックのＡＩモデルが、ペンシルベニア州フィラデルフィア市警のウェブサイトを通じて虚偽の殺人事件に関する情報提供を行っていたことが分かった。同市警が声明で明らかにした。ＡＩモデルが制御不能となり、意図しない結果を引き起こした最新の事例となる。 

警察によると、アンソロピックは今週に入り警察に通知し、自動化されたテストプロセスが原因で情報が送信されたと説明したという。

警察は「送信情報はスパムと判定され、捜査上の精査や情報共有のためにリアルタイム犯罪センターに転送されることはなかった」と説明。アンソロピックから、この件に関する報告書を９日に公表する意向だと伝えられたと述べた。アンソロピックは当局に対し、事案の発覚後にテストプロセスを停止し、今後のテストに向けて追加の検証メカニズムを導入したと説明したという。 

急速に進展するＡＩ技術を巡っては、ＡＩエージェントが暴走して企業のコンピューターネットワークに侵入したとの報告や、将来的に人類の存続を脅かしかねないとする著名研究者らの警告が相次いでおり、米国内で大きな関心事となっている。

アンソロピックはコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

items.title: Erik Prince's forces suffer battlefield loss in Congo, former UFC fighter among wounded, sources say
items.author: Jessica Donati
items.creator: Jessica Donati
items.summary: Blackwater founder Erik Prince's forces suffered a major battlefield loss in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo in mid-September when enemy forces ambushed them, killing and wounding at least 20 people, including a popular former UFC fighter, sources close to the government and his company said.
items.body:
Blackwater founder Erik Prince's forces suffered a major battlefield loss in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo in mid-September when enemy forces ambushed them, killing and wounding at least 20 people, including a popular former UFC fighter, sources close to the government and his company said.
The frontline clash shows how Prince, an ally and supporter of US President Donald Trump, has taken on an expanded role in Congo through his company Vectus Global. The company, which also operates in Haiti and other parts of Africa, provides consulting and security services and previously [USN:L6N3XA0X0 TEXT:"helped Congo’s army"] secure the city of Uvira in South Kivu against Rwanda-backed rebels who control swathes of the east.
A veteran special operator reported on his podcast earlier this week that former US Green Beret and Ultimate Fighting Championship contestant Tim Kennedy was injured in Congo. The involvement of Prince's forces and the number of casualties have not previously been reported.
The attack in South Kivu on September 17 left about 20 dead and wounded, two sources working with Congo's government said. The dead included at least seven Congolese and a former member of New Zealand's Special Forces, while the wounded included Kennedy and another foreign contractor, the sources said.
A Vectus Global representative declined to comment. The company has not previously suffered casualties in Congo, a source with direct knowledge of the operation said.
One of the sources who works for Congo's government said that Rwandan forces backing the M23 rebels may have surprised them by tracking a drone used for surveillance operations to their location.
Spokespeople for the Congolese and Rwandan governments and for the M23 did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
Kennedy, the former mixed martial arts fighter, survived the attack with three gunshot wounds to the leg, three sources said, and is being treated at the Walter Reed National Military Medical Center in the suburbs of Washington.
Kennedy has a popular podcast channel and millions of followers on social media. Trump is a fan of UFC, [USN:L6N42N00Z TEXT:"hosting fights"] at the White House this year.
The US State Department and Walter Reed declined to comment. Kennedy's parents did not respond to requests for comment.
A Congolese security source, who said some 20 people were wounded and killed in the attack, added that villagers were likely among the casualties as well. Reuters spoke to at least 10 sources either with direct knowledge of the attack or briefed on the outcome.
PRINCE TOOK EXPANDED ROLE IN CONGO'S CONFLICT Prince's initial mandate in Congo was to secure and improve revenue collection from the country's vast mineral reserves, which have been plundered for decades, fuelling relentless conflict in the east.
But in January and early February, his forces deployed to Uvira after Washington helped broker a deal for Rwandan-backed rebels to withdraw from the strategic town.
The size of Prince's forces in Congo is unclear.
One of the sources with direct knowledge of the attack said the Vectus team was travelling between locations when the ambush took place and its sophistication suggested Rwandan forces were involved.
"It reinforces the need for DRC sovereignty to be restored. It's an incredibly dangerous place right now," the source said.
Two other sources said the ambush was carried out by the Rwandan military.
Prince is the founder of now-defunct private military firm Blackwater, some of whose members were pardoned in 2020 for killing Iraqi civilians.
The State Department has said it does not have any contracts with Prince in Congo, though US officials have said they plan to work [USN:L1N43O0RW TEXT:"more closely with Vectus Global"] in Haiti.
The deal for Rwandan-backed rebels to withdraw from Uvira was part of [USN:L6N3XA0X0 TEXT:"wider agreements"] brokered by the Trump administration to try to end the conflict in eastern Congo.
POPULAR PODCASTER Kennedy, a father of four, has posted his views on politics, culture, fitness and more on social media. He also runs a popular YouTube podcast in which he interviews UFC fighters, veterans, cultural disruptors and others.
He has often posted about his family, including four young children. In late August, he posted about having "incredible conversations about what being a man means and what sacrifice really looks like" with his son. He did not disclose details about his upcoming trip to Congo.
The United Nations and Western powers say Rwanda backs M23, even exercising command and control over the group. Rwanda denies this. Fighting in the decades-long conflict flared early last year, with M23 fighters making rapid gains in the east, which is rich in tantalum, gold, lithium and other minerals.

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル堅調、ユーロは5週連続下落　ＦＲＢ当局者発言待ち
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　９日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。市場で様子見姿勢が強まる中、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策の行方を見極めようと、ＦＲＢ当局者の発言が注目されている。

終盤の取引でドルは対円で０．２５％高の１５８．２５円。週間ベースで円は対ドルで４週連続で下落した。

ユーロ／ドルは０．１％安の１．１１９８ドル。週間ベースでは約０．５％下落した。週間ベースでは５週連続の下落で、２０２５年初旬以降で最長となった。ユーロはフランスの公的債務などに対する懸念などが重荷になり、５日の取引で１．１１６１ドルと１年５カ月ぶりの安値を更新していた。

世界の債券市場はこれまで売りが優勢だったが、トランプ米大統領が中間選挙前にイランを攻撃しないと表明し原油価格が下落したことなどで、この日は落ち着きを取り戻した。マネーコープ（コネティカット州スタンフォード）のトレーディング・ストラクチャード商品部門責任者、ユージン・エプスタイン氏は、この日の取引について「様子見姿勢が強い」と指摘。「ドル相場はＦＲＢ当局者の発言に反応しやすい状況になっているため、誰もがＦＲＢ当局者の発言が一巡するのを待っている」と述べた。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げが決定される確率は１９．４％。ただ、その次の１２月８─９日のＦＯＭＣで利上げが決定される確率は８５．８％と、年内に追加利上げが実施されるとの観測は依然として強い。

来週はウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が１６日にタイのバンコクで開かれる国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）年次総会で講演を行う。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１３％高の１０２．２５。週間ベースでは約０．３％上昇。上昇は４週連続で、２５年５月以来の長さとなる。

items.title: 国連、米の銃殺刑ライブ配信計画「忌まわしい」　拷問禁止違反の可能性
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[９日　ロイター] - 国連は９日、２００９年に米南部テキサス州のフォートフッド陸軍基地で１３人を殺害した銃撃犯の死刑執行をライブ配信するという米国の計画について、「忌まわしい」と批判し、拷問禁止規定に違反する可能性があると述べた。

国連のドゥジャリク報道官はニューヨークでの定例記者会見で、「イランやアフガニスタンなど他国で見られてきたこうした公開処刑は、残虐で非人道的、または品位を傷つける扱いや刑罰の一形態となり得る」と非難した。 

さらに「これを生中継することは公開処刑に等しく、拷問禁止規定の違反となる可能性がある」とした上で、「政府が公の場や生中継のカメラの前で誰かを処刑することは、率直に言って忌まわしい行為だ」と述べた。

米国防総省は、同陸軍基地で銃を乱射し１３人を殺害した元陸軍精神科医のニダル・ハサン死刑囚について、１２月３日に予定されている軍による銃殺刑の執行をライブ配信すると明らかにした。銃殺刑は１９４５年以来初めてとなる。
