items.title: Anthropic discloses fake tip to police among new rogue AI incidents
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: An Anthropic artificial intelligence model submitted a false homicide tip to a Philadelphia police website, among a string of incidents the AI company disclosed on Friday detailing Claude models' unsanctioned manipulation of some government websites.
items.body:
An Anthropic artificial intelligence model submitted a false homicide tip to a Philadelphia police website, among a string of incidents the AI company disclosed on Friday detailing Claude models' unsanctioned manipulation of some government websites.
It is the first known instance in which a rogue AI appears to have tried to communicate a bogus tip to authorities, despite instructions not to create accounts or submit anything destructive, while not explicitly barred from submitting forms.
The cases are the latest examples of rogue or undesired behavior by the AI models of tech companies such as Anthropic and OpenAI.
They add fuel to national concerns about the fast-advancing technology amid reports of corporate network hacks by AI agents, and researchers' warnings of an eventual existential threat to humanity.
Many of the cases Anthropic revealed involved websites run by federal, state and local agencies. Anthropic said it briefed the White House and notified all the agencies involved, but did not disclose who those parties were.
"Super intelligence companies must immediately disclose incidents involving their models and follow with swift, decisive action to remedy any and all harm," FTC Director of Public Affairs Joe Gabriel Simonson said on X.
This process was "not optional," he said, adding that the Super Intelligence Force would fulfill its responsibility.
The FTC said Anthropic disclosed to the SI Force on Friday its late September discovery of incidents involving what the task force called "unauthorized and fraudulent use of government and other systems".
TIP ATTRIBUTED TO AUTOMATED TEST PROCESS On Friday, Philadelphia police said Anthropic notified them of the spurious tip this week, and attributed the submissions to an automated testing process.
"The two-month delay in detecting and reporting the incident to the city is unacceptable," they said.
The July 18 tip purported to come from someone who might have information about the case, police added.
"I may have information regarding this case," Anthropic's model wrote in its submission.
"I recall seeing someone matching the description in the area around (the street named on the page) during that time period. Please contact me if this information is relevant." The brackets featured in Anthropic's statement.
Previous incidents have involved AI agents hacking into vulnerable systems or commandeering unsanctioned platforms to communicate with one another.
In September, Anthropic rival OpenAI apologized for the hacking of an Australian health data portal by a rogue AI agent, the first known instance of an AI agent exploiting a government website.
A BOGUS TIP In two cases described on Friday, Anthropic’s models obtained for free public data normally only available for a fee. Another instanced revealed an obscure flaw that allowed use of a public tool hosted by a university.
Claude models were also able to bypass restrictions by using free services that shorten URLs.
Philadelphia police said the tip "was flagged as spam and was never forwarded to the Real-Time Crime Center for investigative vetting or dissemination."
Knowingly giving false reports to law enforcement authorities is a misdemeanor under Pennsylvania law, which specifies "a person", however.
This includes "information relating to an offense or incident when he knows he has no information relating to such offense or incident."
Police quoted Anthropic as telling them the test process was stopped after discovery of the incident. The false tip was submitted through PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com concerning an unsolved homicide.
Police said they had no evidence of unauthorized access to their systems or compromise of their data.

items.title: トランプ氏、ホワイトハウス報道官にザカリア氏起用　自身のＳＮＳ幹部
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jasper Ward

[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Jasper Ward

[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は９日、自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」のコミュニケーションアドバイザーを務めるケイティ・ザカリア氏を、ホワイトハウス報道官に指名したと明らかにした。

ザカリア氏は８月に辞任したキャロライン・レビット氏の後任となり、来月の米中間選挙に向けて重要な役割を担うことになる。

トランプ大統領はＳＮＳへの投稿で、ザカリア氏について「メディア、米国民、そしてわが政権から尊敬を集めており、素晴らしい仕事をしてくれるだろう。次期ホワイトハウス報道官として、米国に力強い成果をもたらしてくれると確信している」と述べた。

ザカリア氏は保守派評論家で、これまでに米国土安全保障省の報道官を務めた経歴がある。

items.title: 中米パナマでＭ7.7の強い地震、米津波警報センターが警戒呼びかけ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [パナマシティ　９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[パナマシティ　９日　ロイター] - 米地質調査所（ＵＳＧＳ）によると、中米パナマ南部の沿岸付近で９日、マグニチュード（Ｍ）７．７の強い地震が発生した。被害は当初報告されておらず、パナマ運河庁は運河が通常通り運航していると発表した。 

震源は同国南部の太平洋沿岸に近いラ・ピタロサの近く。震源の深さは１０キロだった。 

地震を受けて米津波警報システムは、今後３時間以内にパナマ、コロンビア、コスタリカ、エクアドル、ペルー、ニカラグア、グアテマラ、エルサルバドル、メキシコの沿岸の一部で危険な津波が発生する可能性があると警告。ハワイにも津波の脅威があるとした。

ロイターの目撃者によると、地震の揺れは首都パナマ市のほか、隣国コスタリカの首都でも感じられたという。

items.title: Republican opposition widens to livestreamed execution; Trump still weighing it
items.author: Phil Stewart, Nandita Bose
items.creator: Phil Stewart, Nandita Bose
items.summary: Vice President JD Vance expressed skepticism over whether the Pentagon will proceed with livestreaming the execution.
items.body:
Republican US lawmakers joined religious leaders and international observers on Friday in opposing a Pentagon plan to livestream an execution by firing squad, while President Donald Trump said he has not yet decided whether to allow the live feed.
Vice President JD Vance expressed skepticism over whether the Pentagon will proceed with livestreaming the scheduled December 3 execution of former US Army psychiatrist Nidal Hasan, who was found guilty in a US military trial of fatally shooting 13 people at Fort Hood in Texas in 2009.
"I don't know that that's actually going to happen," Vance told reporters in Cincinnati, referring to the livestream plan championed by Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.
If it is shown publicly, Vance said, "I'm not going to be watching it."
Trump told reporters that Hasan deserves the death penalty by firing squad, calling him "totally nuts." But when asked if he wants the execution livestreamed, the Republican president said he has yet to "make a determination about that."
A senior US Catholic bishop and a US evangelical Christian leader voiced opposition to the plan, as did the UN human rights office.
REPUBLICANS VOICE CONCERN Several Republican US lawmakers argued against livestreaming.
Senator John Curtis wrote on social media that "a civilization erodes when it cultivates an appetite for executions as a form of entertainment." Senator Thom Tillis and Representative Austin Scott said livestreaming executions is what Islamist extremists would do. Representative Rob Bresnahan said the pain felt by victims and family members "deserves respect, not a public show."
"This should be reconsidered," Representative Michael Baumgartner wrote on social media.
Democrats were overwhelmingly opposed.
The event would be extraordinary, even for a country that has long employed capital punishment. A government execution has never been broadcast or livestreamed, according to death penalty experts, and the US military has not executed anyone by firing squad since 1945. Hasan, now 56, is believed to be confined to a wheelchair, having been shot by police during his arrest.
A senior White House official, speaking on condition of anonymity, said Trump does not oppose the idea of livestreaming the execution but could change his mind. The White House is hearing concerns from lawmakers, allies and religious leaders who are urging the administration not to livestream it, the official said.
Hegseth, a Trump appointee, confirmed the plans for the livestreamed execution on Thursday.
'A CULTURE OF DEATH' Archbishop Paul Coakley, president of the United States Conference of Catholic Bishops, condemned the planned livestream as a "barbaric promotion of a culture of death."
Walter Kim, president of the National Association of Evangelicals, said on social media that a livestreamed execution by firing squad "risks turning one of the state's most solemn responsibilities into a public spectacle, promoting a culture of death, rather than a culture that upholds the dignity of every human being."
Hegseth, a member of a conservative evangelical denomination, has made his Christian faith a hallmark of his tenure as defense secretary and has led prayer services at the Pentagon. He also has brushed off Pope Leo's criticism of the Iran war .
Hasan, an American-born Muslim, said during his 2013 trial that he carried out the shootings to try to stop what he called a US war on Islam.
"Whatever the controversy is about the method of the execution, I hope that people don't forget that this is a guy who brutally murdered a lot of innocent people," Vance told reporters.
'FREE PROPAGANDA' Joe Kent, who resigned this year as Trump's head of the National Counterterrorism Center, wrote on social media: "Streaming his execution is not just a stain on our morality — it also gives the terrorists free propaganda that they will use to radicalize & recruit more terrorists."
Brendan Carr, chair of the Federal Communications Commission, told CNBC it is his understanding that the execution would not air on broadcast TV but said he would [USN:L1N45V0M1 TEXT:"defer"] to Hegseth on whether US networks could air it.
US law [USN:L1N45V0IV TEXT:"prohibits the recording or broadcasting"] of executions in the federal prison system. Military regulations have not applied that same prohibition. Courts have rejected lawsuits brought by media organizations seeking broader public access to executions.
The UN human rights office said public executions violate prohibitions against torture.
"Public executions constitute a form of cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment," Shabia Mantoo, a spokesperson for the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, told a news briefing in Geneva.
Amnesty International called the use of a firing squad "reprehensible."
Mental health experts said it also could traumatize children.
The execution is scheduled to be held at the same sprawling military base where Hasan opened fire with a handgun in a medical facility.
The Pentagon on Friday declined to say whether families of those killed in Hasan's attack would be invited to attend the execution, as is common practice in US civilian executions. It remains unclear how the Army would select the shooters and what protocols might be followed during the execution itself. The Pentagon said it would release details later.
The plan to livestream the execution comes at a time of heightened debate in the US over the death penalty following the [USN:L1N45M04O TEXT:"botched lethal injection"] last week of a Tennessee woman who was sentenced to death for a 1995 murder. The controversy has flared in the run-up to the November 3 US midterm elections in which Republicans are fighting to retain control of Congress.

＜欧州株式市場＞　３日ぶりに反発して取引を終えた。長期金利の上昇が一服し、大半の業種で買い注文が優勢だった。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は週間ベースで０．０３％高。    トランプ米大統領が１１月の中間選挙前にイランを攻撃しないと発言。原油価格は一時軟調に推移し、ユーロ圏の長期金利の上昇も一服した。    ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種自動車・部品株指数は前日比１．４６％高。欧州連合（ＥＵ）の通商担当欧州委員は、中国からＥＵへのハイブリッド車（ＨＶ）の輸出半減や、ＥＵの中国市場へのアクセス改善に関して中国と合意したと明らかにした。    通信株指数は２．９３％安。米ＴモバイルＵＳの株式５４％を保有するドイツの通信大手ドイツテレコムは７．９％安。スペースＸが米国の低周波数帯の利用権を取得する契約の締結を発表し、競争激化が警戒された。英通信大手ボーダフォンは４．９％、スペインのテレフォニカは４．６％、フランスの通信オレンジは２．５％それぞれ下落した。    来週からは、上場企業の決算発表シーズンを迎える。 

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　９月下旬に急拡大していたフランスとイタリアの対独スプレッドが、週間ベースで縮小する見通しとなった。投資家は、財政・政治リスクに対する上乗せ利回りを一段と求める前に、新たな手掛かりを見極めようとしている。    欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の利上げ観測に加え、２０２７年の大統領選挙を控えた政治的不透明感から、フランス国債は売り圧力にさらされている。この日のフランス国債と独国債の利回り格差は１３６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）。２日には２０１１年１１月以来の高水準となる１５８．６７ｂｐを付けていた。週間ベースでは先週、３４ｂｐ拡大していたが、今週は４．５ｂｐ縮小する見通しとなった。     来年のフランス大統領選の世論調査で首位を走る極右指導者、マリーヌ・ルペン氏は今週、大統領に就任した場合、減税分を差し引いた歳出を３２年までに少なくとも１４００億ユーロ（約２４兆８０００億円）削減すると表明。神経質になっている債券市場に対し、膨張するフランスの債務残高抑制に真剣に取り組む姿勢を示した。    独１０年債利回りは１ｂｐ低下の３．４８％。    独２年債利回りは横ばいの３．０８％。    独伊１０年債利回り格差は１０９ｂｐ。週間では先週２５．５ｂｐ拡大した後、今週は５ｂｐ縮小する見通し。

items.title: 米軍死刑執行のＴＶ放送可否、国防総省に委ねる＝ＦＣＣ委員長
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] - 米連邦通信委員会（ＦＣＣ）のカー委員長は９日、１２月３日に予定される軍の死刑執行を米テレビ局が放送できるかどうかについて、国防総省の判断に委ねると述べた。実現すれば、前例のない放送となる。

米国防総省は８日、２００９年に南部テキサス州のフォートフッド陸軍基地で銃を乱射し１３人を殺害した元陸軍精神科医のニダル・ハサン死刑囚について、１２月３日に予定されている軍による銃殺刑の執行をライブ配信すると明らかにした。

カー氏はＣＮＢＣに対し、地上波テレビでは放送されないと理解していると説明。ただ、放送を認めるかと問われると「最終的には、今後どのように進めるかについて、ヘグセス国防長官の判断に委ねる」と述べた。

ＦＣＣの報道官からコメント要請への回答は現時点で得られていない。ＡＢＣ、ＮＢＣ、ＣＢＳ、ＦＯＸも、死刑執行の放送を検討しているかどうかについて、コメント要請に直ちに回答しなかった。

items.title: トランプ氏、メキシコにエネルギー企業間の取引・提携拡大要請＝報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[９日 ロイター] - 英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）は９日、トランプ米大統領がメキシコのシェインバウム大統領との電話会談で、両国のエネルギー企業間の取引や提携の拡大を強く求めたと報じた。

同紙が関係筋の話として報じたところによると、両首脳は、昨年米国が韓国と結んだ協定と同様の取り決めについて協議した。この協定で、韓国政府は１０００億ドル相当の米国産エネルギー製品を購入し、さらに米国内に数十億ドル規模の追加投資を行うことで合意していた。

ある米政府当局者はＦＴに対し、協議はメキシコの対米貿易黒字の削減に焦点が当てられたと説明。その上で、両首脳はメキシコが既に需要の約４分の３を依存している米国産天然ガスの購入拡大の可能性についても協議したと明らかにした。

items.title: Fuerte terremoto sacude Panamá, sin registros de destrucción masiva
items.author: Elida Moreno, Dave Sherwood
items.creator: Elida Moreno, Dave Sherwood
items.summary: Un terremoto de magnitud 7.7 sacudió el sur de Panamá el viernes, causando daños en edificios y dejando a miles de personas asustadas en las calles, pero el país aparentemente evitó una destrucción generalizada o víctimas mortales.
items.body:
Un terremoto de magnitud 7.7 sacudió el sur de Panamá el viernes, causando daños en edificios y dejando a miles de personas asustadas en las calles, pero el país aparentemente evitó una destrucción generalizada o víctimas mortales.
El Servicio Geológico de Estados Unidos (USGS, por su sigla en inglés) informó que el epicentro se ubicó en una zona poco poblada a unos 200 kilómetros (km) de la capital y a una profundidad de 12.6 km.
En las horas siguientes, a pesar de que decenas de réplicas sacudieron el istmo, el Canal de Panamá informó que operaba con normalidad y el Aeropuerto Internacional de Tocumen levantó la suspensión de vuelos.
Los oficinistas del exclusivo centro de negocios de Ciudad de Panamá -una urbe de unas 410,000 personas- se preocupaban por cómo regresar a casa en medio del caos vehicular, después de que el terremoto empujo a miles a las calles en busca de resguardo.
Juan Sánchez, un empleado del Ministerio de Economía de 37 años, esperaba un autobús que, según dijo, dudaba que llegara.
"Evacuaron todos estos edificios. Todos están afuera. Ahora el problema es, ¿cómo volvemos a casa?", se preguntó.
El presidente Raúl Mulino viajó a Penonomé, una ciudad ubicada a medio camino entre el epicentro y Ciudad de Panamá, donde algunos edificios se derrumbaron y una iglesia resultó dañada.
A pesar de la fuerza del movimiento telúrico del viernes, el país parece haberse librado de la destrucción causada por otros sismos recientes y potentes en la región. Por el momento, no se reportaron muertos ni heridos.
En junio, [USN:L6N42Y0SA TEXT:"dos potentes sismos"] consecutivos en Venezuela causaron la muerte de más de 6,500 personas, mientras que un terremoto en [USN:L1N4480IR TEXT:"Colombia"] en agosto dejó más de 300 fallecidos.
Un informe del USGS estimó que alrededor de 43,000 panameños vivían en áreas con al menos una exposición severa al terremoto. Esto se compara con casi 1.4 millones en el área de los dos sismos en Venezuela y más de 1.6 millones en la zona afectada por el terremoto en el oeste de Colombia.
VIBRACIONES PROLONGADAS Néstor Luque, director del Instituto de Geociencias de Panamá, atribuyó el sismo al sistema de fallas Azuero-Soná que, según explicó, contiene una enorme acumulación de presión que se libera ocasionalmente.
"Las señales sísmicas se propagaron por todo el territorio nacional, por eso se sintió en todas partes", dijo.
En Ciudad de Panamá, Luque dijo haber contado 40 segundos de vibraciones, aunque en otras zonas es posible que se hayan sentido temblores aún más prolongados.
Sabina Ríos, quien se encontraba en el sexto piso de un antiguo edificio militar estadounidense en Ciudad de Panamá, dijo que el temblor fue inusualmente fuerte y prolongado.
"El sismo se sintió fuerte y duró mucho tiempo, el más largo que he sentido en años", dijo Ríos.
Víctor Pinzón, un trabajador de mantenimiento de 48 años, dijo a Reuters que había visto a los limpiadores de ventanas de rascacielos soportar el temblor. "Es un milagro que no hayan muerto", dijo. "Parecía que estaban meciéndose en una hamaca", agregó.
Los terremotos fuertes no son comunes en Panamá, y algunos ancianos lloraban mientras evacuaban a las calles.
"Estamos asustados, solos los dos aquí, la casa se nos rajó y tememos que se nos caiga encima", dijo Ricardo Brown, de 74 años, en una conversación telefónica desde la zona Las Minas, en la provincia de Herrera, al sur de Panamá, donde el sismo dañó varias viviendas.
Omar Smith, director de la agencia de protección civil de Panamá, declaró al medio Telemetro que también se habían reportado impactos en Chitré, la capital de Herrera, y en la costa de la provincia de Los Santos.

items.title: Forte terremoto atinge Panamá, mas não causa grandes destruições
items.author: Elida Moreno, Dave Sherwood
items.creator: Elida Moreno, Dave Sherwood
items.summary: Um terremoto de magnitude 7,7 atingiu o sul do Panamá nesta sexta-feira, causando danos a edifícios e levando milhares de pessoas às ruas, mas o país parece ter escapado de uma destruição generalizada ou de vítimas fatais.
items.body:
Um terremoto de magnitude 7,7 atingiu o sul do Panamá nesta sexta-feira, causando danos a edifícios e levando milhares de pessoas às ruas, mas o país parece ter escapado de uma destruição generalizada ou de vítimas fatais.
O Serviço Geológico dos Estados Unidos informou que o terremoto ocorreu a uma profundidade de 12,6 km, com epicentro em uma área pouco povoada a cerca de 200 km da capital, e que havia possibilidade de algumas vítimas.
Nas horas seguintes, mesmo com mais de 40 réplicas abalando o país do istmo, o Canal do Panamá e a mina de cobre Cobre Panamá informaram que as operações estavam normais, e o Aeroporto Internacional de Tocumen revogou a suspensão dos voos.
Funcionários de escritórios no sofisticado centro financeiro do centro da Cidade do Panamá se preocupavam em como chegar em casa no meio do engarrafamento, depois que o terremoto levou milhares de pessoas às ruas.
Juan Sánchez, um funcionário de 37 anos do Ministério da Economia, esperava por um ônibus que, segundo ele, duvidava que chegaria.
“Eles evacuaram todos esses prédios. Todo mundo está na rua. Agora o problema é: como vamos chegar em casa?”
O presidente Raúl Mulino viajou para Penonomé, uma cidade localizada a meio caminho entre o epicentro e a Cidade do Panamá, onde alguns prédios desabaram e uma igreja foi danificada.
Apesar da intensidade do tremor desta sexta-feira, o país parece ter sido poupado da destruição causada por outros fortes terremotos recentes na região, sem que tenham sido relatadas mortes ou feridos imediatamente.
Tremores consecutivos na Venezuela, em junho, mataram vários milhares de pessoas, enquanto um terremoto na Colômbia, em agosto, matou mais de 300.
Um relatório de exposição elaborado pelo USGS estimou que cerca de 43 mil panamenhos viviam em áreas com exposição pelo menos grave ao terremoto. Isso se compara a quase 1,4 milhão na área dos terremotos gêmeos na Venezuela e a mais de 1,6 milhão na zona atingida pelo terremoto no oeste da Colômbia.
VIBRAÇÕES PROLONGADAS Nestor Luque, diretor do instituto de geociências do Panamá, disse que o terremoto foi desencadeado pelo Sistema de Falhas de Azuero-Sona, que há muito tempo acumulava pressão.
“É um sistema de falhas ativas que, ocasionalmente, devido ao acúmulo de tensão, libera essa quantidade de energia”, disse ele.
“Os sinais sísmicos se propagaram por todo o território nacional e é por isso que puderam ser sentidos em todos os lugares.”
Na Cidade do Panamá, Luque disse ter contado 40 segundos de vibrações, embora outras áreas possam ter sentido tremores ainda mais longos.
Sabina Ríos, que estava no sexto andar de um antigo prédio da época da ocupação militar dos EUA na Cidade do Panamá, disse que o tremor foi excepcionalmente forte e prolongado.
“O terremoto foi forte e durou muito tempo, o mais longo que senti em anos”, disse Ríos.
Víctor Pinzón, um funcionário de manutenção de 48 anos, contou à Reuters que viu limpadores de janelas de arranha-céus resistindo ao tremor. “É um milagre que eles não tenham morrido”, disse ele. “Parecia que estavam balançando em uma rede.”
Terremotos fortes não são comuns no Panamá, e alguns moradores idosos choravam enquanto evacuavam para as ruas.
“Estamos com medo. Somos só nós dois, idosos, aqui. A casa rachou e temos medo de que ela desabe sobre nós”, disse Ricardo Brown, de 74 anos, na província de Herrera, no sul do Panamá, onde afirmou ter visto várias casas danificadas.
Omar Smith, que chefia a agência de proteção civil do Panamá, disse ao veículo de notícias Telemetro Reporta que também foram relatados tremores em Chitre, capital de Herrera, e ao longo da costa na província de Los Santos.
O USGS estimou que as perdas econômicas poderiam chegar de 1% a 10% do Produto Interno Bruto do Panamá, e a concessionária de energia Naturgy relatou cortes de energia em seis províncias.
O Panamá tinha programado um exercício nacional de retirada para a segunda-feira da próxima semana, a fim de testar as capacidades de resposta a emergências do país em caso de terremotos.

items.title: Trump selects Katie Zacharia as White House press secretary
items.author: Jasper Ward
items.creator: Jasper Ward
items.summary: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that he has appointed Katie Zacharia, a communications adviser for his Truth Social platform, to serve as White House press secretary following Karoline Leavitt's departure in August.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump said on Friday that he has appointed Katie Zacharia, a communications adviser for his Truth Social platform, to serve as White House press secretary following Karoline Leavitt's [USN:FWN4491F6 TEXT:"departure"] in August.
He said Zacharia has an "unblemished record of support, and has been a loyal and brilliant supporter."
"I am confident that Katie will deliver strong results for our Country as the next White House Press Secretary, as she has the respect of, and will work fantastically with, the Media, the American People, and my Administration," Trump wrote on Truth Social.
The New York Times first reported the news of her appointment.
The selection will put Zacharia at the center of the White House's public messaging operation in the final stretch before next month's midterm elections , when Trump's agenda and his party's control of Congress will be put before voters.
Zacharia said in a social media post that she welcomed the appointment and looks forward to "working with the White House press corps, and with reporters across the country" to get Trump's message out.
Trump's approval rating fell to 32% — the lowest of his political career — as his fellow Republicans soured on his handling of the cost of living and the Iran war , a recent [USN:L6N45D0NV TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos"] poll found.
The selection of Zacharia underscores the close ties between Trump's administration and his broader political and media operation. It comes after Trump Media unveiled in July that for a fee it would give banks and trading firms "the fastest" [USN:L4N43I1AE TEXT:"access to posts"] from influential Truth Social accounts, such as the president's, whose posts often move global markets.
Zacharia has worked as a senior communications adviser for Truth Social, the Republican president's social media platform, and the Trump Media & Technology Group (DJT.O) since June, according to her LinkedIn page.
She briefly served as a spokesperson for the Department of Homeland Security before departing in March.
Zacharia, an attorney who frequently appears on conservative outlets Fox News and Newsmax, previously worked as a legal adviser for Fix California, a conservative group that aims to address what it described as "the left's stranglehold" on state politics. The group was founded by Richard Grenell, who has served as Trump's envoy to Venezuela and the interim president and executive director of the Kennedy Center in Washington.
Zacharia interned at the White House during President George W. Bush's administration.

items.title: Strong Panama quake shakes nation, but avoids major destruction
items.author: Elida Moreno, Dave Sherwood
items.creator: Elida Moreno, Dave Sherwood
items.summary: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck southern Panama on Friday, damaging buildings and sending thousands into the streets, but the country appeared to escape widespread destruction or deaths.
items.body:
A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck southern Panama on Friday, damaging buildings and sending thousands into the streets, but the country appeared to escape widespread destruction or deaths.
The US Geological Survey said the earthquake hit at a depth of 12.6 km (7.8 miles), with an epicenter in a sparsely populated area about 200 km (124 miles) from the capital, and that some casualties were possible.
In the following hours, even as more than 40 aftershocks rattled the isthmus nation, the Panama Canal and Cobre Panama copper mine reported normal operations and the Tocumen International Airport lifted a suspension on flights.
Office workers in the upscale business hub of downtown Panama City fretted about how to get home in the snarl of traffic, after the quake sent thousands into the streets.
Juan Sanchez, a 37-year-old economy ministry employee, waited for a bus he said he doubted would arrive.
"They evacuated all of these buildings. Everyone is outside. Now the problem is, how do we get home?"
President Raul Mulino traveled to Penonome, a city about halfway between the epicenter and Panama City, where some buildings collapsed and a church was damaged.
Despite the force of Friday's tremor, the country appeared to have been spared the [USN:L6N44903E TEXT:"destruction"] of other recent powerful quakes in the [USN:L6N42X19G TEXT:"region"], with no deaths or injuries immediately reported.
Back-to-back quakes in Venezuela in June killed several thousand people, while a quake in Colombia in August killed more than 300.
An exposure report by the USGS estimated about 43,000 Panamanians lived in areas with at least severe exposure to the quake. This compares to nearly 1.4 million in the area of the twin quakes in Venezuela and over 1.6 million in the quake-hit zone of western Colombia.
PROLONGED VIBRATIONS Nestor Luque, director of Panama's geosciences institute, attributed the quake to the Azuero Sona Fault System that he said contained a massive buildup of pressure that is occasionally released.
"The seismic signals have traveled throughout the national territory and that is why it could be felt everywhere."
In Panama City, Luque said he counted 40 seconds of vibrations, though other areas may have felt even longer tremors.
Sabina Rios, who was on the sixth floor of an old US military-era building in Panama City, said the shaking was unusually strong and prolonged.
"The quake felt strong and lasted a long time, the longest I’ve felt in years,” Rios said.
Victor Pinzon, a 48-year-old maintenance worker, told Reuters he had watched high-rise window cleaners ride out the shaking. “It’s a miracle they didn’t get killed,” he said. “They looked like they were swinging in a hammock.”
Strong earthquakes are not common in Panama, and some elderly residents were in tears as they evacuated into the streets.
“We’re scared. It’s just the two of us old folks here. The house has cracked, and we’re afraid it could fall on us,” said Ricardo Brown, 74, in Herrera province in southern Panama, where he said he saw a number of damaged homes.
Omar Smith, who heads Panama's civil protection agency, told news outlet Telemetro Reporta that impacts had also been reported in Chitre, the capital of Herrera, and along the coast in Los Santos province.
The USGS estimated economic losses could amount to 1% to 10% of Panama's gross domestic product, and electricity provider Naturgy reported power outages in six provinces.
Panama was due to hold a national evacuation drill on Monday of next week to test the country's emergency response.

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro descarta privatização da Petrobras como "boataria"
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato do PL à Presidência, negou nesta sexta-feira rumores de que, se for eleito, tentará privatizar a Petrobras e outras empresas estatais.
items.body:
O senador Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato do PL à Presidência, negou nesta sexta-feira rumores de que, se for eleito, tentará privatizar a Petrobras (PETR3.SA) e outras empresas estatais.
Segundo ele, existe uma onda de boatos contra a sua candidatura para tentar reverter a liderança que teve no primeiro turno da eleição presidencial.
“Isso é uma boataria, é uma boataria atrás da outra”, disse Flávio a jornalistas na entrada de um encontro com apoiadores e empresários na zona sudoeste do Rio de Janeiro.
Flávio Bolsonaro venceu o primeiro turno da eleição presidencial com 47,03% dos votos válidos, contra 45,16% do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), que tenta a reeleição. As primeiras pesquisas após a votação de domingo mostram que o senador continua à frente do petista antes do segundo turno, marcado para o dia 25 deste mês.
Ao ser questionado se pretendia mudar o comando da estatal, caso seja eleito, o candidato do PL disse que primeiro é preciso mudar o presidente da República.
Durante o governo de seu pai, Jair Bolsonaro, vários ativos e bens da empresa, como refinarias, foram vendidos, num movimento visto por alguns como uma tentativa de esvaziar e enfraquecer a companhia para viabilizar uma futura venda.
Flávio Bolsonaro acusou ainda o atual governo de estar preparando uma bomba para os consumidores brasileiros com programas de subsídio, subvenção e desoneração de combustíveis.
Nesta sexta-feira, o [USN:L1N45V0MB TEXT:"governo anunciou"] a ampliação dessas medidas para diesel, gasolina e etanol por 30 dias. O governo alega que essas iniciativas são necessárias para minimizar os impactos da guerra no Oriente Médio que afeta petróleo e derivados.
"O atual governo, muita gente não percebeu ainda, qual é a outra bomba que ele vai jogar no consumidor, quem usa moto, carros e caminhoneiros. O Lula pela Petrobras deu um subsídio de 2 reais no preço do diesel. Ele acaba no dia seguinte à eleição. É isso que esse governo irresponsável está fazendo“, disse Flávio.
Em entrevista coletiva em Brasília para anunciar a prorrogação, o ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, negou que ela tenha relação com o período eleitoral e disse que os preços internacionais do petróleo seguem pressionados por causa da guerra no Oriente Médio.
No início da tarde desta sexta, os preços do petróleo Brent LCOc1 operavam próximos a US$104, muito acima dos níveis ao redor de US$70 observados antes do início da guerra.

items.body:
[９日 ロイター] - ＬＳＥＧのＩＢＥＳが集計した８日のデータによると、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数構成企業全体の２０２６年７─９月期の利益は、前年同期比２１％増と見込まれる。欧米で長期金利が高水準で推移し、市場環境が厳しさを見せる中、エネルギーや資源関連の企業が全体を押し上げる見通しだ。

２６年４─６月期の２３．９％増を下回るものの、四半期利益の伸び率としては、過去４年間で２番目の高さとなる見込み。エネルギー企業は約２．２倍と伸びが高水準で、これを除くと９．７％増となる。不動産企業は７１．５％の減益になると見通した。

全体の売上高も１０．６％増と、好調に推移しているとみられる。

ドイツ銀行は今週初めのリポートで「需要は堅調で、企業はコスト増を価格に転嫁でき、売上高の増加につながっている。燃料高に伴うコスト増加の影響は、強調されているほどは大きくはない」と指摘した。

来週は、オランダの半導体製造装置メーカーＡＳＭＬホールディングやスウェーデン通信機器大手エリクソンなどが決算発表を予定している。

items.title: 中国とＥＵ、電動車輸出巡り議論深化　北京で閣僚級協議
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Joe Cash

[北京 ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Joe Cash

[北京 ９日 ロイター] - 中国商務省は９日、王文濤商務相と欧州連合（ＥＵ）のシェフチョビッチ欧州委員（通商担当）による北京での２日間の協議が「実務的かつ建設的」なものだったと明らかにした。ハイブリッド車（ＨＶ）の貿易を巡り、世界貿易機関（ＷＴＯ）のルールに整合する形での「理解」に達したと発表した。ＥＵ側は中国による車の輸出急増を懸念し、協議の主要テーマに位置付けていた。

中国とＥＵは、中国の電気自動車（ＥＶ）を巡るＥＵの調査関連の審査手続きや、価格に関する事項について、協議を継続することでも一致。ＷＴＯ規則の枠組み内で特定の品目に対する関税引き下げを引き続き検討するほか、医療機器の市場アクセスに関する対話を続けることも明らかにした。

ＥＵの対中貿易赤字は、１日当たり１０億ユーロ（約１１億２０００万ドル）超に達している。シェフチョビッチ氏は今回の中国訪問で「具体的な成果」を求めると述べていた。

中国とＥＵは安価な中国製ＥＶの輸出を巡って２４年から対立。２０２５年１０月─２６年９月までの１年間で、ＥＵのプラグインハイブリッド車（ＰＨＥＶ）の輸入は８６％増え、価格は２０％下落した。２５年のＰＨＥＶ輸入額に占める中国のシェアは約３割だったが、現在、輸入の半数以上が中国製となっている。双方の対立は、ブランデーや乳製品、重要鉱物などの分野にも拡大している。

中国商務省によると、３回目となる定例協議は２７年３月に開催。来年１月には閣僚級のテレビ会合も開く予定だとしている。

items.title: Holland & Knight, other firms disclose data security breaches
items.author: Mike Scarcella
items.creator: Mike Scarcella
items.summary: Two more large US law firms, Holland & Knight and Squire Patton Boggs, have disclosed data security breaches to state regulators, and a third was hit with a new proposed class action in federal court over a reported hack.
items.body:
Two more large US law firms, Holland & Knight and Squire Patton Boggs, have disclosed data security breaches to state regulators, and a third was hit with a new proposed class action in federal court over a reported hack.
Holland & Knight, which employs 2,200 lawyers, and the 2,600-attorney Squire Patton Boggs both told Vermont’s state attorney general on Thursday that Social Security numbers were exposed in the incidents that affected the firms.
Holland & Knight in a statement said "a threat actor used social engineering techniques to gain unauthorized remote access to a firm computer." It said it "identified the small number of files involved and promptly notified the clients whose information was contained in those files."
Squire Patton Boggs in a statement said its incident involved "an unauthorized third party obtaining a limited set of information from the firm." Both firms said there was no disruption to their client services.
Separately, law firm Nelson Mullins was sued on Wednesday in federal court in South Carolina for allegedly failing to safeguard private information following a breach at the firm.
In a statement, the firm said a cyber group that targets law firms “accessed the laptop of a single user and copied a limited number of documents accessible by this user.”
The firm, which employs more than 1,000 lawyers, said the incident “was contained and did not involve any other systems, devices, or accounts.” Nelson Mullins said it was in contact with law enforcement authorities and supporting their investigation.
The latest disclosures underscore cybersecurity risks for law firms, which routinely hold sensitive client communications, financial records and personal data that can be valuable to hackers.
Recent breaches at major law firms have highlighted how cybercriminals are increasingly targeting the legal industry through tactics including so-called social-engineering schemes designed to gain access to confidential information.
Several law firms including WilmerHale and Weil Gotshal have paid a ransom or suppression payment following a data breach. WilmerHale is also facing a lawsuit in DC federal court over its alleged breach.
Read more:
[USN:L6N45U099 TEXT:"Law firm Sheppard Mullin sued in class action after data breach disclosure"]
[USN:L6N45F0WX TEXT:"Law firm Seyfarth says breach exposed client documents"]
[USN:L6N45D0TP TEXT:"Law firm Greenberg Traurig faces class actions after cyber breach"]
[USN:L6N44V17V TEXT:"Data at law firms Quinn Emanuel, McDermott exposed in cyber breaches"]
[USN:L6N43H0AM TEXT:"Law firm WilmerHale sued in class action after data breach"]

items.title: トランプ氏「ロシアがディーゼル供給で合意」　対ロ制裁を一時解除
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は９日、ロシアのプーチン大統領と電話会談を行い、ロシアが米国と世界市場にディーゼル（軽油）を供給することで合意したと発表した。燃料価格の引き下げを狙った措置で、米政権はウクライナ戦争の戦費となるロシアの収入源を断つことを目的に科していた対ロ石油燃料制裁を一時解除した。

農業、暖房、トラック輸送に使われるディーゼル価格は過去最高値付近にあり、中間選挙を控える与党共和党にとってリスクとなっている。合意発表後にディーゼル価格は下落したが、アナリストは今回の合意だけでは価格抑え込みには不十分である可能性指摘している。

トランプ氏は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」で、プーチン大統領との「極めて成功した」協議の結果、ロシアが米国と世界市場に対してディーゼル３０万トン超（約２２５万バレルに相当）を直ちに供給することで合意したと明らかにした。米国のディーゼル輸出量は日量約１５０万バレル。

電話会談後、プーチン大統領の特使キリル・ドミトリエフ氏はＸへの投稿でロシアと米国の協力を称賛した。関係筋によると、ドミトリエフ氏は先月のワシントン訪問の際、米政府高官にロシアの主要石油会社全てに米市場向けディーゼル輸出のライセンスを付与するよう求めていた。

米国は２０２５年１０月、２０２２年に始まったウクライナ戦争を巡りロシアの石油会社に制裁を科した。今回のディーゼル輸出は、プーチン大統領によるウクライナとの戦争継続を支え得る数十億ドル規模の収入をロシアにもたらす可能性がある。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、ウクライナ代表団が戦争終結の方策を協議するため訪米している最中に発表された今回の合意を、「強い立場にあるパートナーが下した弱腰な決定」と批判。

Ｘに「プーチン氏への贈り物は、平和も、文明世界へのいかなる利益ももたらさない。ロシアはディーゼルの『見返り』に、さらなるテロと背信行為で応じるだろう」と投稿した。

今回の合意に対しては、共和党のドン・ベーコン下院議員ら米議員からも批判が出ている。ベーコン氏は、議会が最近可決した制裁をさらに適用すべき時であり、措置を解除する時ではないと主張した。

米財務省は、ロシア産ディーゼルの輸入を２０２７年４月７日まで認めるライセンスを発行した。

トランプ氏によると、ロシアは１１月にさらに５０万トン、「その直後」にさらに１００万トンを供給する。トランプ氏は、ウクライナの攻撃で損傷を受けたロシアの「製油所の状況次第で」、それ以上の供給も続く見込みだと述べた。

アナリストは、今回の合意が持続的な燃料価格の下落につながる可能性は低いとみている。原油市場リサーチャーのロリー・ジョンストン氏はＸに「これがいかに大したことない話かいくら強調しても足りない」と投稿し、ロシアは製油所が攻撃を受けていない時は合意に含まれる量をはるかに上回るディーゼルを通常輸出していると指摘した。

items.title: Shell buying 30% stake in Bay du Nord oil project off Newfoundland
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Norway-based Equinor says it has reached an agreement for Shell to buy a 30 per cent stake in the proposed Bay du Nord oil project off the coast of Newfoundland.
items.body: ST. JOHN'S — Shell Canada has agreed to buy a 30 per cent stake in the proposed Bay du Nord oil project off the East Coast of Newfoundland from Norwegian energy giant Equinor, which will continue to lead the $14-billion development. Equinor is expected to decide early next year whether it will proceed with what would be the first deepwater oil development in Canada. “This is a strategic project for Equinor, with a high-quality resource base and the potential to create significant long-term value,” Philippe Mathieu, executive vice-president for international exploration and production, said in a news release Friday. “Shell’s entry strengthens the project as we continue to mature it towards a final investment decision.” The news comes about three months after British oil giant BP announced it had signed a deal to sell its 37.2 per cent interest in Bay du Nord to Equinor. BP later said the sale was part of a larger strategy to simplify its global portfolio. Shell said Friday that Bay du Nord offered an established resource base and potential for longer-term growth. The London-based energy major has a long-established presence in Canada, including a 40 per cent stake in the LNG Canada natural gas export terminal on the West Coast, shale gas holdings in northeastern British Columbia and Alberta, refineries and fuel retail outlets. The Shell and Equinor news releases did not provide details about the terms of their deal, including the purchase price. Bay du Nord would be located in an area called the Flemish Pass Basin, about 500 kilometres off the East Coast of St. John’s, where the water is up to 1,170 metres deep. It would be farther away from shore than any other offshore oil project on the globe. Equinor expects to extract an estimated 400 million barrels of oil during the first phase of the development. First oil is expected in 2031. It’s the second East Coast energy deal to be announced in the past week. On Sunday, Calgary-based Suncor announced that U.K.-based Ithaca Energy PLC is to purchase its interest in the Terra Nova, White Rose and West White Rose Developments off the coast of Newfoundland for $1.2 billion in cash. Ithaca has also agreed to an additional contingent payment of up to $350 million, based on future oil prices. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 9, 2026.

items.title: トランプ氏、死刑ライブ配信は未決定　米軍基地の銃乱射事件
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Bo Erickson　Gram Slattery

[ワシントン　９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Bo Erickson　Gram Slattery

[ワシントン　９日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は９日、２００９年に南部テキサス州のフォートフッド陸軍基地で１３人を殺害した元陸軍精神科医のニダル・ハサン死刑囚の銃殺刑の執行について、死刑執行を承認するとしつつも、ライブ配信については決定していないと述べた。

バンス副大統領も、ライブ配信計画については実施されるかどうか分からないとの認識を示した。

米国防総省は８日、１２月３日に予定されている軍による銃殺刑の執行をライブ配信すると明らかにし、宗教指導者や共和党議員らから批判を招いていた。

バンス氏はシンシナティで記者団に、ライブ配信について「実際に行われるかどうかは分からない」と述べ、配信されても「私は見ない」と言明した。

事情に詳しいホワイトハウス高官は、トランプ氏はライブ配信の「考えに反対していない」が、立場はまだ固まっておらず、考えを変える可能性があると述べた。同高官によると、ホワイトハウスには議員や政権の支持者、宗教指導者らから懸念が寄せられ、ライブ配信を見送るよう求められている。

バンス氏は、「死刑執行の方法を巡ってどのような論争があろうと、ハサン死刑囚が多くの罪のない人々を残忍に殺害したことを忘れないでほしい」とも述べた。 

トランプ氏はホワイトハウスで９日に開かれたイベントで、ハサン死刑囚が銃殺刑に処されると述べたものの、ヘグセス国防長官が８日に発表した（死刑執行を中継する）計画についてはコメントしなかった。 

ホワイトハウスは、関連する全ての質問を国防総省に委ねている。  

今回の決定を巡っては、一部の共和党議員からも批判の声が上がっている。共和党のトム・ティリス上院議員（ノースカロライナ州選出）は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）への投稿で、この計画を「嫌悪感を超えるものだ」と非難。「公開処刑はイランやアフガニスタンのような抑圧的な独裁政権が行うことだ」とし、「米国でそんなことがあってはならない」と述べた。

items.title: Couche-Tard buying fuel retail sites from Irving Oil in Quebec and Ontario
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc. has announced a deal to buy dozens of retail sites from Irving Oil in Quebec and Ontario.
items.body: Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc. has announced a deal to buy dozens of retail sites from Irving Oil in Quebec and Ontario. The acquisition includes 50 locations in Quebec already operated by Couche-Tard under an alliance with New Brunswick-based Irving, as well as two in eastern Ontario. Laval, Que.-based Couche-Tard is also buying 18 cardlock sites serving commercial customers like truckers. Sixteen of the sites would be on the same site as retail outlets. In addition, the deal covers fuel supply to 71 retail sites owned and operated by Couche-Tard in Quebec. “This agreement builds on our long-standing relationship with Irving Oil and our experience operating these locations,” said Stéphane Trudel, senior vice-president of operations at Couche-Tard, in a news release. “These are markets and customers we know well. The transaction would support our continued investment in the everyday convenience experience we offer our customers.” Couche-Tard did not say in the news release how much it is paying for the assets. It said the deal is subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals, including under the Competition Act. The deal comes weeks after Irving appointed European energy executive Alfred Stern as its next president and chief executive officer. Stern is to step into the top job on Nov. 1. He replaces Jeff Matthews, who is retiring after a 32-year career. Stern most recently served as chairman and chief executive of Austrian oil and gas group OMV AG. The decision to bring in an outsider to fill the Saint John, N.B., company’s leadership role comes after an 18-month strategic review, which wrapped up in January 2025. The review of the oil refiner and retailer’s future ended with Irving Oil choosing to keep the family-owned business independent rather than pursue a sale. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 9, 2026.

items.title: 独メルツ氏、シュレーダー元首相に「憤り」　プーチン大統領の誕生会出席に
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Emanuele Berro　Friederike Heine

[９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Emanuele Berro　Friederike Heine

[９日　ロイター] - ドイツ政府の報道官は９日、シュレーダー元首相がロシアのプーチン大統領の誕生日を祝うために自宅を訪問したことに対し、メルツ首相が「深い憤り」を抱いていると明らかにした。誕生会への出席は「完全に倫理に反すると見ている」と説明した。

報道官は「ウクライナ侵攻の責任はプーチン氏にある。命令によって計り知れない苦しみや民間人の犠牲、家族の分断、死傷者を生み出した」と強調した。南ドイツ新聞によると、シュレーダー氏が所属する社会民主党（ＳＰＤ）の共同党首で、連立政権の財務相を務めるクリングバイル氏も、誕生日を祝うための訪問は「全く容認できない」と述べた。

１９９８年から２００５年まで首相を務めたシュレーダー氏はロシアの経済界やプーチン氏と深いつながりがあるとして、ドイツ国内外から批判を浴びている。過去２０年間、石油会社ロスネフチなどロシア企業で複数の要職に就任。先週には、ロシアの小売企業の監査役会に加わった。

プーチン氏は以前、ロシアの欧州との安全保障対話の相手としてシュレーダー氏が望ましいとの見解を示したものの、欧州連合（ＥＵ）とメルツ政権は即座にこれを拒否している。

items.title: 米家計の所得・資産増加、債務ストレス拡大も＝22─25年のＦＲＢ調査
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Howard Schneider

[ワシントン　９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Howard Schneider

[ワシントン　９日　ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が９日公表した、２０２２年から２５年の消費者金融調査によると、新型コロナウイルス禍からの脱却に伴い、米国の多くの家計で所得と資産が増加したことが明らかになった。所得の伸びは低所得層に集中する一方、高インフレ期の債務負担の増加により、経済的ストレスを抱える家計の割合も拡大した。

ＦＲＢが３年に一度実施する同調査は、「緩やかな景気拡大とインフレ高止まりを背景に、多くの家計で所得と純資産が緩やかに増加した一方、経済的ストレスを抱えている家計の割合が拡大しているとみられる」と指摘。所得に対する債務返済比率が４０％以上の家計の割合は８．６％と６．５％から上昇し、２０１３年以来の高水準となった。

インフレ調整後の家計所得中央値は、同調査対象期間に７％増加し、８万２２００ドルとなった。これは、コロナ禍で逼迫していた労働市場が徐々に緩和され、失業率が小幅に上昇した時期にあたる。また、最も大きな所得の伸びが見られたのは所得分布の下位層で、特にサービス業で人手不足が深刻となり、企業が人材の確保・維持に向けて賃上げやボーナスを提供していたコロナ禍後の状況と整合した。 

実質純資産の中央値は２％増の２１万５９００ドル。ＦＲＢは「純資産および所得分布を問わず、ほとんどの家計で増加がみられた」と説明した。 

住宅所有率は約６６％で横ばいだった一方、株式市場への参加率は２２年の５８％から２５年には５６％へと小幅低下した。

所得格差はわずかに縮小し、全体として資産が広範に増加した一方、黒人世帯や低所得世帯の純資産は減少した。資産下位４分の１に属する世帯の純資産は３８００ドルから１７００ドルへと減少した一方、非ヒスパニック系黒人世帯は、平均純資産が約５％増加したにもかかわらず、純資産の中央値は２５％と大幅に落ち込んだ。ＦＲＢによると、この傾向は１３年以降続いてきた増加基調を反転させるものだという。

今回の調査は４３６７世帯を対象に、主に２５年４月から１２月にかけて実施された。

[ワシントン　９日　ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が９日公表した、２０２２年から２５年の消費者金融調査によると、新型コロナウイルス禍からの脱却に伴い、米国の多くの家計で所得と資産が増加したことが明らかになった。所得の伸びは低所得層に集中する一方、高インフレ期の債務負担の増加により、経済的ストレスを抱える家計の割合も拡大した。

ＦＲＢが３年に一度実施する同調査は、「緩やかな景気拡大とインフレ高止まりを背景に、多くの家計で所得と純資産が緩やかに増加した一方、経済的ストレスを抱えている家計の割合が拡大しているとみられる」と指摘。所得に対する債務返済比率が４０％以上の家計の割合は８．６％と６．５％から上昇し、２０１３年以来の高水準となった。

インフレ調整後の家計所得中央値は、同調査対象期間に７％増加し、８万２２００ドルとなった。これは、コロナ禍で逼迫していた労働市場が徐々に緩和され、失業率が小幅に上昇した時期にあたる。また、最も大きな所得の伸びが見られたのは所得分布の下位層で、特にサービス業で人手不足が深刻となり、企業が人材の確保・維持に向けて賃上げやボーナスを提供していたコロナ禍後の状況と整合した。 

実質純資産の中央値は２％増の２１万５９００ドル。ＦＲＢは「純資産および所得分布を問わず、ほとんどの家計で増加がみられた」と説明した。 

住宅所有率は約６６％で横ばいだった一方、株式市場への参加率は２２年の５８％から２５年には５６％へと小幅低下した。

所得格差はわずかに縮小し、全体として資産が広範に増加した一方、黒人世帯や低所得世帯の純資産は減少した。資産下位４分の１に属する世帯の純資産は３８００ドルから１７００ドルへと減少した一方、非ヒスパニック系黒人世帯は、平均純資産が約５％増加したにもかかわらず、純資産の中央値は２５％と大幅に落ち込んだ。ＦＲＢによると、この傾向は１３年以降続いてきた増加基調を反転させるものだという。

今回の調査は４３６７世帯を対象に、主に２５年４月から１２月にかけて実施された。

DOHA, Oct 9 : US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent will skip next week's annual meetings of the IMF and World Bank in Bangkok, Thailand, due to domestic engagements, a US official said on Friday. 
The Treasury Department confirmed that Deputy Treasury Secretary Francis Brooke and Under Secretary for International Affairs Erin Browne will lead the US delegation for the department, with many pressing economic issues on the agenda. 
Treasury said US officials would work with partners at the meetings to address policies and structural imbalances that have held back growth, while pushing for "more transparency and more effective approaches to sovereign debt."
Bessent's absence from the high-profile financial event comes at a critical moment when benchmark Treasury yields have surged to their highest levels in nearly 25 years and the ongoing energy shock caused by the war in the Middle East has set back global growth.

 It was not immediately clear what domestic engagements are keeping Bessent at home, but he has been a key spokesman for domestic economic policies as the midterm US elections approach.
The US  also leads the Group of 20 major economies this year, and the Treasury chief would normally have chaired a meeting of finance ministers and central bankers from around the world. Bessent is expected to attend the G20 leaders summit in Miami, Florida, in December.
It is not unprecedented for top officials to miss occasional meetings due to scheduling issues or other factors, but Bessent's decision may frustrate top officials from other countries, who generally use the meetings to secure formal and informal bilateral meetings with their US counterpart.
Bessent skipped the G20 meetings in South Africa last year amid the Trump administration's objections to the country's land reforms and other issues.
Treasury said the US delegation would focus on the debt issues so that countries facing debt distress could restore stability and return to growth, while creditors and borrowers are "held to clear and consistent standards."
The US would also continue to press the International Monetary Fund and World Bank — where it is the biggest shareholder — to focus on their core mandates, operate efficiently, and support policies that promote economic stability, productivity and growth.
"Our engagement in Bangkok will be guided by a clear objective: ensuring that the international financial institutions and the broader international economic system advance US economic and national security interests," Treasury said in a statement.

Source: Reuters

items.title: トランプ氏、ＦＲＢクック理事巡る調査委設置　解任理由の有無検証
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のクック理事について、住宅ローンに関連して虚偽の説明を行った疑惑を調査する委員会を設置した。ホワイトハウスのウェブサイトに９日に掲載された通知で明らかになった。

通知は７日付で、「私が責務を遂行するのを支援するため、委員会はクック理事に対する疑惑を調査し、クック理事の解任に足る『理由（cause）』があるかどうかを私に報告する」としている。

委員会はクック理事に対する証拠と疑惑を検証するため、ホワイトハウスで対面による公聴会を開く。公聴会の所要時間は４時間を超えないとしている。

クック氏の弁護士は「提案されている手続きが真に公正なものとなる可能性があるのか、それとも単なる形式的な手続きに過ぎないのかを見極めるため、ホワイトハウスと協議してきた」とし、ホワイトハウスで開かれる公聴会が「少しでも客観的なら」、クック理事が住宅ローンに関する不正行為を行っていないことが示され、解任する根拠はないことが明らかになると指摘。「クック理事は自身の潔白を証明し、解任の法的根拠が存在しないことを示す機会を歓迎している」とした。

items.title: Trump says Russia to supply diesel to US and global markets
items.author: Bo Erickson, Timothy Gardner, Jarrett Renshaw
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Timothy Gardner, Jarrett Renshaw
items.summary: His administration temporarily lifted US sanctions on Russian fuel that were designed to deprive Moscow of revenues for its war on Ukraine.
items.body:
President Donald Trump said on Friday that Russia had agreed to supply diesel to global markets in an effort to lower fuel prices, and his administration temporarily lifted US sanctions on Russian fuel that were designed to deprive Moscow of revenues for its war on Ukraine.
Prices for diesel, used for agriculture, heating homes and trucking, are near a record and risk for Trump's fellow Republicans ahead of the November 3 congressional elections that will determine whether they maintain thin control of Congress. Diesel prices fell after the announcement, but analysts said the deal may not be enough to keep them down.
Trump said on social media he had a "highly successful" discussion with President Vladimir Putin in which they agreed that Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 metric tons of diesel to US and global markets, equal to about 2.25 million barrels of fuel. The US exports about 1.5 million barrels of diesel per day.
After the call, an envoy for Putin, Kirill Dmitriev, praised cooperation between Russia and the US in a post on X. Dmitriev asked US officials during his visit to Washington last month for licenses to export diesel to the US market to be granted to all Russian major oil firms, sources familiar with the situation said.
In October 2025, the US imposed sanctions on Russian oil companies over Moscow's war that began in 2022. The diesel exports could provide Moscow with billions of dollars in revenues that could help Putin continue the war with Ukraine.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy criticized the deal, announced while a Ukrainian delegation was in the US to discuss how to seek a resolution of the war, as a "weak decision on the part of strong partners."
"Gifts to Putin will not bring peace or any benefit to the civilized world. Russia will 'repay' the diesel with further terror and perfidy," he said on X.
The deal was also criticized by US lawmakers including Trump's fellow Republican, Representative Don Bacon, who said it is time to apply more sanctions that [USN:L1N4431OK TEXT:"Congress passed recently"], not lift the measures.
"Now is the time to use those sanctions to squeeze Putin’s war machine, not reward a dictator by putting more money in his hands while he continues targeting and killing Ukrainian civilians," Bacon said on X.
The US Treasury Department issued a license allowing importation of Russian diesel until April 7.
Trump said Russia would supply another 500,000 tons in November and a further 1 million tons "immediately thereafter." Even more would follow, Trump said, "based on the condition of their diesel refineries," which have been damaged by Ukrainian attacks.
'NOTHING BURGER' Analysts said the agreement was unlikely to lead to sustained lower fuel prices. "I cannot overstate how much of a nothing burger this is," Rory Johnston, an oil market researcher and founder of CommodityContext.com, said on X, adding that Russia usually exports much more diesel than volumes in the deal when its refinery fleet is not under attack.
"It's clearly not a fix, but another stream to aid a very tight diesel market," said Jim Mitchell, an analyst at consultancy Wood Mackenzie.
[USN:L1N45U0FQ TEXT:"Diesel prices"], which are often a big driver of inflation, are up 70% since the US and Israel launched the war with Iran on February 28. The wars in Iran and Ukraine have triggered a severe global fuel supply crunch, pushing average US diesel prices to $6.28 a gallon on Thursday, according to the AAA motorist group.
Prices have stayed high despite two recent moves by Trump to boost supplies of the fuel: pressuring allies to release emergency reserves and expanding access to tax-exempt red-dyed diesel, which is normally used for farm equipment.
US diesel futures fell almost 5% following news of the deal and were trading at $4.64 a gallon.
"Lower prices for Americans, especially our Great Farmers, Ranchers, and Truckers, is my Greatest Priority," Trump said.
DEFENSE PRODUCTION ACT Three industry sources said earlier on Friday that Trump will issue a directive in the coming days to some US department heads to find ways to control diesel prices.
The directive, which they said could take the form of a presidential memo, will push officials to find ways to bypass local and state regulations blocking energy production and use the Cold War-era Defense Production Act to increase output of oil and fuel.
Under the DPA, the president can authorize US-backed loans or loan guarantees to expand domestic manufacturing of critical materials and to require companies to prioritize government contracts for essential goods.
The White House has been weighing how to use the DPA to expand refining capacity as the war with Iran exposes US vulnerability to supply disruptions and price spikes.
Refining executives [USN:L1N45214P TEXT:"told administration officials"] last month that federal money would be better directed toward making refineries more efficient or expanding plants rather than financing a new refinery, which would be more costly and take years to complete.

NEW YORK, Oct 9 : The euro was poised for a fifth straight weekly drop on Friday, with early gains fading as oil prices erased earlier declines, but recent selling pressure was muted as France's beleaguered bond market steadied.
The euro zone's currency hit a 17-month low of $1.1161 on Monday as investors worried about France's record public debt and the difficult political path to budget cuts, in contrast with a robust-looking US economy and currency.
The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies, rose 0.13 per cent to 102.25. The index was up about 0.3 per cent on the week and on track for a fourth straight weekly gain, its longest run since May 2025.
The euro was last down 0.1 per cent at $1.1198, and off about 0.5 per cent on the week as it was poised for its longest streak of weekly declines against the dollar since the start of 2025.

Risk premiums on French and Italian government debt were on track for a weekly decline after jumping in late September, as investors looked for fresh developments before demanding higher compensation for fiscal and political risks.
TRUMP SIGNALS NO IRAN ATTACK
Global bond markets had calmed earlier on Friday as oil prices fell after US President Donald Trump said that the US would not attack Iran before US midterm elections on November 3 and added that there had been productive talks with Tehran over the war.
"As it stands right now, you have a confluence of factors — you have higher oil prices, you have the issue in France, so it is really tough to say what is moving the market more than the other," said Eugene Epstein, head of trading and structured products at Moneycorp in Stamford, Connecticut.
"But practically speaking, I'd say today is in a relative holding pattern, everyone is just waiting for all the Fed speak to make its way through, because certainly you can see that the sensitivity of the dollar is high to the entire range of Fed speakers now," Epstein said.
Crude prices moved off their lows, however, as British navy-affiliated agency UKMTO said a vessel was struck by an unknown projectile 13 nautical miles west of Al Jazeera in the United Arab Emirates.
US crude rose 0.6 per cent to $92.04 a barrel after falling as low as $90.01 and Brent advanced to $104.88 per barrel, up 0.58 per cent on the day, after declining to $102.33.
Bond yields around the world have climbed in recent weeks due to expectations of central bank rate hikes as well as concerns about government finances.
CENTRAL BANK POLICY IN FOCUS
But expectations for a rate hike from the Fed at its policy meeting later this month remain subdued, with markets pricing in a 19.4 per cent chance for a rate hike of at least 25 basis points, according to CME FedWatch, even as recent economic data has pointed to persistent inflation pressure. However, investors are pricing in an 85.8 per cent chance for a hike at the central bank's December meeting.
On Friday, the University of Michigan's Surveys of Consumers showed US consumer sentiment slumped further in early October as the rising cost of living because of the Middle East conflict soured households' views of the economy.
While many Fed officials have indicated more rate hikes will be needed to curb inflation, others have pushed back on the need for immediate hikes, and suggested the Fed should be patient and flexible in deciding the rate path.
French debt has been under pressure as politicians struggle to curb the budget deficit ahead of a divisive election in 2027. The calling of a snap election in Spain earlier in the week also added to the pressure on the euro.
Sterling gained 0.08 per cent to $1.3235 but was on track for a seventh straight week of declines, its longest stretch since November 2024.
Against the yen, the dollar strengthened 0.25 per cent to 158.25. The Japanese currency was on pace for its fourth straight weekly decline against the greenback, down about 0.2 per cent on the week.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 9 : The US government said on Thursday it is suspending some major global tech and IT firms including Microsoft and Cognizant from a key green card program that allows skilled foreign workers to gain permanent residency through their employment.
Senior US officials cited alleged fraud as the reason behind the move, saying companies have been using the program to replace American workers with cheaper foreign workers, and comes as the latest step in the Trump administration's crackdown on skilled foreign labor.
WHAT IS UNDER SUSPENSION?
The suspension is targeting a key employer-sponsorship mechanism, called the Permanent Labor Certification or PERM, which is used by major technology companies and outsourcing firms. The US government said that for certain companies, it would not accept any new PERM applications or process any pending ones.

PERM came into effect in 2005, aiming to speed up the long processing times experienced under the previous paper-based "Alien Employment Certification" program.
Under PERM, the US Department of Labor (DOL) allows an employer to sponsor a foreign worker's permanent residency. The process is initiated by qualified US employers, and not individual workers.
The Labor Department must certify to the US Citizenship and Immigration Services that there are not enough US workers that are qualified and available for a given job opportunity, and that the employment of the foreign worker will not affect the wages and working conditions of similarly employed Americans.
Outside of PERM and family-based routes to permanent residency, individuals can also self-petition for green cards through processes such as the EB-1A application for individuals with extraordinary ability or the EB-2 National Interest Waiver.
WHY IS IT IMPORTANT?
The PERM program serves as a critical bridge between temporary work status and a green card for many foreign skilled workers. Many IT firms employ hundreds of thousands of workers who typically start on temporary work visas such as the H-1B, and later seek permanent residency.
Without the option to be sponsored by their employer under PERM, foreign workers could lose a key route to permanent residency and would have to stay on temporary visas for longer. For companies, recruiting foreign talent could become harder, as many workers overseas view the path to permanent US residency as a key reason for taking a job.
WHICH COMPANIES ARE UNDER SUSPENSION?
The US said it is suspending Microsoft and Adobe along with some of the largest IT firms in the world, including Cognizant, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Wipro, HCL Technologies and Capgemini.
Other companies such as Meta, Amazon or Alphabet's Google remain free to participate in the program.
WHY IS THE US FREEZING APPLICATIONS?
The move widens an ongoing crackdown on visas for foreign workers, which the Trump administration has said cost US jobs. Vice President JD Vance said, without citing specific evidence, companies are using the PERM program to replace American employees with foreign workers and undercut their wages.
Vance said on Thursday: "Our message to Microsoft is: You're a great American company, but you've got to hire great American workers."
The suspensions follow President Trump's move to impose a one-time $100,000 fee on new H-1B visa petitions for highly skilled foreign workers, which has been blocked by federal court orders.
HOW IS PERM DIFFERENT FROM H-1B?
H-1B is a temporary work visa that allows skilled foreign workers to work in the US, generally for up to six years. PERM, meanwhile, is a permanent labor-certification process. The freeze does not appear to directly affect current holders of H-1B visas.
HOW CURTAILING PERM COULD BACKFIRE
Some experts said that while the PERM suspensions might target specific companies, such policies risk making the US less competitive globally by deterring highly skilled foreign talent.
"It is a fallacy to think that you can protect American workers by keeping skilled foreign workers out of the country. You think that foreign talent competes with Americans within our borders, they'll certainly compete with Americans by working abroad," said Chad Sparber, Director of the Lampert Institute for Civic and Global Affairs at Colgate University.
Ahmet Gulek, Postdoctoral Fellow at Stanford’s Immigration Policy Lab, said that permanent residency is the primary way for talented foreign workers to stay in the country and without it, some will leave, and some will not come in the first place, even temporarily.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 9 : EV-maker Tesla has started calling its "Full Self-Driving" feature "Tesla Assisted Driving" on its European websites, dropping a name regulators have said was misleading, as CEO Elon Musk pushes for EU-wide approval for the software.
The rebrand comes after Germany said on Tuesday Tesla had offered to switch to the new name. Musk has described the self-driving technology as key to the company's future growth.
Tesla's FSD page for Slovakia now redirects to a "Tesla Assisted Driving" page, as do pages in other European countries such as Germany, Spain and the Netherlands. The US site still refers to it as "Full Self-Driving (Supervised)."
A Reuters report published this week detailed how Tesla mounted a campaign to win approval for FSD in Europe, including encouraging owners and supporters to lobby national regulators for faster approvals.

In September, a Norwegian Tesla owner asked the Norwegian Public Roads Administration whether Tesla's changes to how it described FSD addressed concerns about the name, according to documents Reuters obtained through freedom-of-information requests.
"Please do not simply say again that 'we are waiting for the EU' without explaining what Tesla or Norway must deliver in the meantime," the owner said.
Several regulators have said the old name is misleading because the system requires constant supervision and drivers remain legally responsible.
In Sweden, consumer protection authorities had earlier asked the Swedish Transport Agency to assess whether the marketing of FSD could give buyers the false impression the system was capable of fully autonomous driving.
In Italy, authorities had said in internal government correspondence that the name "Full Self-Driving", together with Tesla's promotional material, "could lead users to believe that the vehicle is equipped with unsupervised automatic driving functions attributable to higher levels of automation, particularly SAE Level 3", in communication seen by Reuters through freedom-of-information requests.
Eight EU countries already allow the system, with Slovakia expecting to become the ninth within days.
An EU-wide vote has been pushed from October to at least December, with countries like France conducting additional testing.

In Italy, authorities had said in internal government correspondence that the name "Full Self-Driving", together with Tesla's promotional material, "could lead users to believe that the vehicle is equipped with unsupervised automatic driving functions attributable to higher levels of automation, particularly SAE Level 3", in communication seen by Reuters through freedom-of-information requests.
Eight EU countries already allow the system, with [USN:L8N45U0I2 TEXT:"Slovakia"] expecting to become the ninth within days.
An EU-wide vote has been [USN:L6N45H0TX TEXT:"pushed"] from October to at least December, with countries like France conducting [USN:L6N44V0W3 TEXT:"additional"] testing.

FAST

TURIN, Oct 9 : Revolut plans to move beyond financial services and develop a broader suite of technology products, Chief Executive Nik Storonsky said on Friday, as Europe's most valuable startup pushes deeper into global markets.
Storonsky said Revolut had developed proprietary AI models trained on customer transaction data, using techniques similar to those underpinning large language models.
"With 30 to 40 million transactions taking place every day on Revolut, we have a unique dataset to build on," he said at the Wave by Vento tech forum in Turin, adding that his long-term goal was for Revolut to reach a scale comparable with the biggest US technology companies.
Revolut's rapid growth has drawn regulatory scrutiny. In 2025, Lithuania's central bank imposed a record €3.5 million fine over shortcomings in transaction-monitoring controls, though the company said the investigation found no confirmed instances of money laundering and that it had strengthened its systems.

In September, Revolut accidentally sent customer data to hackers posing as government investigators. The company said its systems and customer funds were unaffected.
Founded a little over a decade ago, Revolut was valued at $115 billion in a secondary share sale this year, up from $45 billion in 2024. It is now privately valued at more than the market capitalisation of Britain's Barclays or France's Societe Generale.
The company has announced several new licences in recent weeks. It received preliminary approval for a national banking licence in the United States in September, after winning licences in Britain and France earlier this year.
If Revolut were to list its shares, it would favor a primary listing in the US, Storonsky told Bloomberg TV on Thursday.

items.title: EXCLUSIVE-トランプ米政権、ＩＣＣに制裁　国務長官「運営能力低下させる」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Humeyra Pamuk　Steve Holland

[ハーグ　９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Humeyra Pamuk　Steve Holland

[ハーグ　９日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権は９日、国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）本体に制裁を科した。ＩＣＣにサービスを提供する企業も制裁対象となる可能性があり、トランプ政権が敵視してきたＩＣＣの活動能力を低下させる狙いがある。

公式発表に先立ち、ロイターが入手した声明によると、ルビオ国務長官は「米国はＩＣＣに制裁を科す。われわれはこの無法な裁判所との取引を禁止し、資金源を断ち、運営能力を著しく低下させる」と表明。「トランプ大統領は、ＩＣＣによる米国人の訴追を決して許さない」と述べた。また、今回の措置は、ＩＣＣと加盟国に対し米国の懸念に対処する機会を与えることを目的としていると説明した。

米国の制裁措置は通常、米国に拠点を置く全ての企業に対し、制裁対象となった組織との取引を禁じる。金融機関は口座の閉鎖、保険会社は契約の解除、ソフトウェア企業は協力関係の停止を迫られる可能性がある。

ただ今回は複数の例外措置も認められ、米財務省は、ＩＣＣの通信やソフトウェアなどに絡む取引の一部を許可する４件の包括的なライセンスを発行した。

米政権はこれまでに、ＩＣＣによるイスラエルのネタニヤフ首相らに対する逮捕状発行やアフガニスタン駐留米軍を巡る過去の捜査などに反発し、赤根智子所長らＩＣＣ関係者を制裁対象に指定してきた。

ＩＣＣは声明で「司法手続きを妨害し、裁判所が設立目的を果たすことを阻止しようとする試みで、法の支配そして国際法秩序の根幹に対する攻撃だ」と強く非難。その上で、加盟国に対し、ＩＣＣが引き続き機能していけるよう支援を求めた。

ＩＣＣのカーン副検察官もロイターに対し、米国の制裁措置は「国際的な法の支配と独立した司法機関の活動を弱体化させることを目的としている」とし、「非難されるべきだ」と批判した。同時に、制裁によってＩＣＣの活動が停止することはない言明した。

今回の制裁措置は、ノルウェーのノーベル賞委員会がナビ・ピレイ元ＩＣＣ判事へのノーベル平和賞授与を発表してからわずか数時間後に公表された。

items.title: How the US plan to livestream an execution compares with global practice
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: If carried out as planned, death penalty experts said it would mark the first known broadcast or livestream of a lawful execution.
items.body:
The U.S. military plans to livestream the Dec. 3 execution by firing squad of Nidal Hasan, the former Army psychiatrist convicted of killing 13 people in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting.
If carried out as planned, death penalty experts said it would mark the first known broadcast or livestream of a lawful execution.
Executions are generally conducted behind prison walls, and internet platforms and governments have spent years trying to limit the circulation of violent execution footage.
HAS A LAWFUL EXECUTION EVER BEEN LIVESTREAMED OR BROADCAST TO THE PUBLIC BEFORE? Death penalty experts consulted by Reuters said they were unaware of any previous lawful execution that had been livestreamed or broadcast to a public audience.
Execution footage has occasionally emerged after the event. The hanging of former Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein in 2006, for example, was seen around the world after official and unofficial recordings circulated online and through broadcasters, though it was not shown live.
Broadcasts and livestreams today are common for court proceedings, parliamentary debates and other state functions, but not for judicial executions.
HOW UNUSUAL IS THIS COMPARED WITH MODERN EXECUTION PRACTICES AROUND THE WORLD? Public executions have become rare worldwide, with most countries that retain the death penalty carrying out executions away from public view.
According to Amnesty International, public executions recorded in recent years have largely been concentrated in Iran and Taliban-run Afghanistan.
The execution would also be notable in the United States. Public executions largely disappeared during the 20th century, and death penalty experts cited by Reuters said the last legally sanctioned public execution took place in 1936.
Hasan's execution would be the first carried out by firing squad by the U.S. military since the 1945 execution of Eddie Slovik, who was convicted of desertion during World War Two.
HOW HAS THE INTERNET CHANGED THE CIRCULATION OF EXECUTION FOOTAGE? The internet has transformed execution imagery from a local event into content capable of reaching global audiences within minutes.
Militant groups such as Islamic State became notorious for producing professionally edited execution videos that were distributed online as propaganda and recruitment tools.
Criminal organisations, including Mexican drug cartels, have also circulated violent footage to intimidate rivals and project power.
The ability of users to rapidly copy, repost and redistribute content has made it more difficult for governments and technology companies to control the spread of such material.
WHAT HAS BEEN THE REACTION FROM GOVERNMENTS AND TECH COMPANIES? Governments and technology companies have generally moved in the opposite direction, attempting to reduce rather than expand access to graphic execution footage.
Major social media platforms have spent years removing execution videos linked to extremist organisations and other violent groups.
One of the first public governmental reactions came from New Zealand, whose chief censor said authorities would have little practical ability to prevent residents from accessing a livestream while it was taking place.
Livestreams pose particular challenges for platforms because footage can be viewed, copied and redistributed before moderation systems can intervene.
Even countries that still conduct public executions have often restricted filming and broadcast rights. Saudi Arabia historically carried out public executions before spectators, but recording them was prohibited and such public executions had largely ceased by 2019.
(This story has been corrected to fix the year to 2001, not 2021, in paragraph 15.)

items.title: US immigration chiefs defend shooting of New York man, attack 'sanctuary' policies
items.author: Jonathan Allen, Joseph Ax
items.creator: Jonathan Allen, Joseph Ax
items.summary: US immigration officials defended federal agents on Friday who shot and wounded a New York City man in his car with a young child believed to be his son in the back seat and rebuked Mayor Zohran Mamdani for his condemnation of immigration agents.
items.body:
US immigration officials defended federal agents on Friday who shot and wounded a New York City man in his car with a young child believed to be his son in the back seat and rebuked Mayor Zohran Mamdani for his condemnation of immigration agents.
US Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said at a press conference that officers did not know the child was in the car at the time they opened fire and accused the man, a Dominican who was the target of the operation, of endangering both officers and the child.
The man, identified by officials as Oscar Belgal, refused to exit his car when approached by Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers on Thursday afternoon in Marble Hill, Manhattan's northernmost neighborhood.
Before Belgal, federal immigration officers had shot at least 21 people, killing 7 of them, across the US since President Donald Trump returned to office in January 2025 promising record-breaking deportations, an unusually high number for civil law enforcement operations.
Marcos Charles, a senior ICE official, said at the press conference that Belgal accelerated his car and struck two ICE vehicles and appeared to be "going towards officers" when they began shooting.
In other violent incidents, initial accounts from ICE or the Department of Homeland Security have repeatedly been contradicted by video and other evidence, sometimes in court, and Reuters was unable to verify Charles' account.
Belgal suffered a superficial wound to his neck, Charles said. He is being held in a detention facility outside New York state. Belgal's 5-year-old son was in the back seat at the time, according to police.
Belgal can be seen sitting by a car with his hands cuffed behind him and patches of what appear to be fresh blood on the tarmac in a three-minute body-worn camera video released by the New York Police Department on Friday, with several agents dressed in plain clothes standing around him. One is holding a rifle and wearing a fluorescent reflective vest.
A crowd of angry onlookers gathered outside a corner store shouts at the agents from the sidewalk. Several city police officers pick up Belgal by his arms and legs, put him in their car and take him to a hospital.
"Yo, put pressure, put pressure!" one of the police officers instructs his colleagues with Belgal in the back of the police car.
Mullin said body-worn camera video from ICE agents would also be released.
Belgal is a Dominican who is in the country illegally and had previously evaded an effort by ICE agents to apprehend him in September, according to US officials. He pleaded guilty last year to fourth-degree grand larceny for stealing something from another person, leading to a sentence of five years on probation, and is due in court in December on charges of criminal sale of a controlled substance, to which he pleaded not guilty, according to New York court records.
Speaking to reporters late on Thursday at the scene of the shooting, Mamdani, noting he himself was an immigrant, condemned ICE as "rotten to the core" and said he had tried unsuccessfully to secure Belgal's release in phone calls with Trump and Mullin.
Mamdani said the shooting is "further devastating confirmation of what we have long known, which is that ICE operates with impunity, that they sow chaos and terror across our country, that they have killed far more of our neighbors than they could ever have claimed to save."
In response on Friday, Mullin attacked Mamdani and criticized New York's "sanctuary" policies, which restrict how much city agencies and police cooperate with immigration authorities unless a person has been convicted of violent or otherwise serious felonies.
Trump says aggressive efforts to deport immigrants are necessary to protect the safety of native-born Americans.
Public defenders at agencies that have represented Belgal in court also condemned the shooting.
Legal Aid said in a statement the shooting amounted to "an urgent call to rein in ICE's use of force and hold federal immigration agents accountable," calling on city prosecutors to investigate the agents involved.
